row.name: G.E.A.R: Great Engineers Are Rats
row.detailed_description: DISCLAIMER G.E.A.R is a Free to Play demo version that is missing many features like progress saving, optimizations and QoL improvements. The game will not be updated or receive any bug fixes. About the game Save the resort! After receiving a distress call from a wildlife resort, you and you rat companion Gustavo embark on a mission to fix the surrounding wind turbines. For years, the park had been inhabited by a family of rats who have now mysteriously disappeared. Unfortunately, their presence has left the park inoperable. Destroyed by rats, saved by another. There's something poetic there, no? Without the turbines functioning, the resort's filtration system could malfunction, so a lot is at stake! Can you save the animals? Challenge yourself with a series of unique physics-based puzzles. Arrive at the park, help Gustavo solve innovative puzzles using realistically simulated physics in order to fix all wind turbines. See the environment change as you make progress in your maintenance! Explore the wind park, take in the beautiful scenery and relax. Each level more challenging than the last, use the supplied objects to clear a path to the exit! Bombs, fans, gears and more are at your disposal. How will you solve each puzzle? The fate of the wildlife resort lies within your paws!
row.short_description: A first person game with 2D, realistically simulated, physics-based puzzles.

What makes this game stand out is that with each round, you'll receive a different weapon, calling upon your ability to adapt and improvise to prevail over your opponent. row.name: Loud Run
row.detailed_description: ' Loud Run ' is an exciting multiplayer online adventure! Set across various maps, this competitive game pits players as either Runners or Chasers. The main objective is for the Chaser to catch the Runners, or for the Runners to take down the Chaser. Invite your friends or join a server to embark on this thrilling adventure! Key Features: 2-12 Player Multiplayer Experience: Engage in fun and competitive matches with friends or players from around the world. Each match revolves around the Runners developing strategies to evade the Chaser, while the Chaser strives to catch the Runners. Surprise Chaser Selection: At the start of the game, one player is randomly chosen as the Chaser and begins in a safe zone. The other players must implement strategic plans to stop the Chaser and survive. Strategic Mechanics: When the Chaser attacks, they must shout. While shouting, their breath gradually depletes. Once their breath is completely exhausted or they stop shouting, the Runners can damage the Chaser. However, while the Chaser is shouting, the only option for the Runners is to run! This dynamic requires players to constantly adjust their strategies and work as a team. Scoring System: If the Runners catch the Chaser off guard and manage to defeat them, each surviving Runner earns 1 star. If you are the Chaser and successfully catch all the Runners, you win the game and earn 1 star. As rounds progress, the first player to reach the predetermined number of stars achieves individual victory. ' Loud Run ' offers a fun and exciting experience filled with strategic thinking and surprises. Prepare yourself for this thrilling school adventure and enjoy the game!
row.short_description: 'Loud Run' is a 2-12 player fun multiplayer game. The Chaser tries to catch all the Runners within the range of their voice. When the Chaser runs out of breath, it's the Runners' turn to take down the Chaser. Prepare your breath; a looooong adventure awaits you!

Click to generate hearts, invest them in powerful upgrades, and watch your heart count soar. Can you unlock all the upgrades and achieve the ultimate heart collection? Click to Generate Hearts: Start with zero hearts and click your way to a growing heart collection. Upgrade Your Abilities: Spend your hearts on a variety of upgrades to increase your heart production. Idle Progression: Earn hearts even when you're not actively playing. Come back to a wealth of hearts and new opportunities. Unlock New Skins and Cosmetics: Customize your game by unlocking new heart skins and other exciting cosmetic items. Charming Graphics: Enjoy cute and colorful visuals as you grow your heart collection. Endless Fun: See how many hearts you can collect Get new items as you play, items can be earned once per hour Join the heart-collecting frenzy and see how far you can go in Heart Clicker!
row.short_description: Heart Clicker is a free-to-play clicker/idle game where you start with nothing and build your way up to a vast collection of hearts! Click to generate hearts, invest them in powerful upgrades, and watch your heart count soar.

row.name: A Better Tomorrow
row.detailed_description: A Better Tomorrow is a minimalist 2D city-building environmental clicker game that focuses on green energy. Your goal is to supply clean energy to your citizens while preserving the environment for an in-game week. Build green energy generators and plant trees to achieve this. Immerse yourself in this cozy and relaxing experience and learn about green energy. In A Better Tomorrow, you must manage three resources: energy, the environment's health, and the limited space available. The game's primary resource is energy, which is used to build new generators and satisfy the energy demands of villages and cities. When you construct new generators, the environment suffers. Heal the environment by planting saplings and seeing them grow into beautiful trees! The game presents a strategic challenge with its five types of energy generators: windmills, solar panels, dams, gas plants, and nuclear plants (on July 6, 2022, the UE Parliament labeled gas and nuclear power as green, equating them with renewables). Each generator has unique attributes, and weather conditions can influence their production. As the game progresses, new villages and cities will appear, increasing the energy demand. Adapt your strategy to optimize production and maintain a balance! What A Better Tomorrow Offers: Relaxing, calming, and atmospheric gameplay. Four unique unlockable themes. A set of challenges that spice up the gameplay with new weather conditions. A mix of resource management and strategy mechanics. 18 trophies. What A Better Tomorrow Does Not Offer: Any combat or violence. Multiplayer. Narrative elements, storyline. Turn-based strategy.
row.short_description: Join the green revolution! 🌱 Relax and learn about clean energy in this cozy, minimalist 2D city-building clicker game. Build windmills, solar panels, and more to provide energy to villages and cities while protecting the environment. Let's work together to make 'A Better Tomorrow'!

row.name: None Shall Intrude: Descent
row.detailed_description: WELCOME TO PROLOGUE OF NONE SHALL INTRUDE!In this free version, you are able to conquer the first Act of Herelon. Will you be able to defeat the Dragon Slayer and secure the first part of the map? None Shall Intrude invites you to embrace the unparalleled power of a Raid Boss in a unique and immersive gaming experience. Prepare to traverse vibrant realms, engage in intense battles, and conquer all who dare to challenge your dominance. As the embodiment of chaos, your reign will be defined by strategic prowess, unique tile interactions with elemental flavor, boss mechanics you learn as you play. CHAOS INCARNATE As the unkillable embodiment of chaos, death means nothing to you as your soul is permanently tied to this land of mortals! With each new life, you gain more power, and each cycle opens up new possibilities to grow stronger. CONQUER THE WORLD  Forge your journey by selecting different routes from nodes on the map, ultimately conquering full regions .Along the way, you'll explore a variety of vibrant and imaginative landscapes , each filled with unique obstacles and creatures. Whether it's dense woodlands , majestic snowy mountains , or boundless desert sands . The world of Herelon is full of diverse location for you to explore and conquer! ELEMENTAL COMBOS Navigate the battlefield using a tile-based system, employing various primordial elements and combine them into potent interactions. Discover all 18 possible tile interactions and tailor your build to your preferred style of play, destroying your enemies with style! TALENTS  Level up your boss to unlock many new cards and relics . Accumulate talent points to invest in a talent tree , which can be customized before each run, enabling you to adapt your boss's play style to suit your preferences. BOSS MECHANICS  As the Chaos Incarnate , you possess 3 Phases . The road to power means unlocking your latent 'Boss Mechanics' . These mechanics work across distinct phases, with 24 unique powers attainable through in-game achievements . Combine up to 4 'Boss Mechanics' to craft your personalized Raid Boss . RELICS As you conquer regions or defeat powerful foes , you'll acquire special relics to enhance your elemental tile interactions even more. WHAT TO EXPECT IN THE FULL VERSION OF THE GAME: Access to the entire map, with many new unique Heroes to beat. Many new cards, talents and boss mechanics for the Dragon Boss. 5 new Difficulties (heroes play 2 cards, random affixes, etc..). Weather effects during combat (sand storm, blizzard,..). New dynamic combat backgrounds with unique combat objectives. Cosmetic Customizable Cave for the Dragon Boss. Mini-game Nodes, Locked special Nodes. Random Merchant events.
row.short_description: None Shall Intrude: Descent is a free Prologue version of None Shall Intrude. A roguelite deck-builder with tile-based combat where you become a powerful Raid Boss. Epic battles, intricate strategies, and the ever-present threat of heroic challengers seeking to vanquish your reign.

row.name: swingmania
row.detailed_description: Early access warning Please note: We are making this game available early in a raw work in progress state. If you are not interested in testing an extremely unfinished game you should wait until the full release. During Early Access you should expect to see the following: Placeholder UI elements that reserve space for planned features but do not work yet. These are part of the game development process and will be made functional over time. Some features may be in a broken or unfinished state or temporarily disabled while the underlying features are being worked on. Placeholder models, textures and low quality graphics. These are part of the game development process and we plan to create higher quality assets over time. Placeholder maps. None of the songs in game include the full intended range of beatmaps and difficulties, and some songs may only have one difficulty available that might be too difficult to most players. A lot of maps are temporary and we plan to make higher quality maps over time. Random game server outages General bugs A lot of planned features are not implemented yet. You can scroll down to the Early Access Roadmap section to get a rough idea of what's planned. Description swingmania is a note slicing VR rhythm game focused at competitive ranked play, customizability, ultra high performance and cats! Earn Delicious PP and climb the ranks The game includes a built in ranked system that lets you see where you stand in the world. Compete to become the #1 swingmania player, or see how far you can make it on the ranked ladder. Playing ranked maps, such as the built in maps, will award you Performance Points (PP) based on the maps difficulty and your score. The bigger your total PP is, the higher your global rank will be! Multiple note types The game features multiple types of notes, including Colored notes which have to be hit using a specific hand Rainbow notes that can be hit with either hand Any direction notes that can be hit in any direction Directional notes that have to be hit in a specific direction Mines that must be avoided Walls that you must avoid with your head Wide range of built in maps The base game includes a bunch of songs with maps ranging from very easy accuracy maps all the way to random angle challenge, squat challenge and 688 bpm vibro. Please keep in mind that during Early Access the selection of songs and maps is limited, and we plan to add more songs and maps for every type of player over time. Custom songs support Map your own song collection with full freedom in note placement using swingmapper, our advanced map editor which is included with the game. Designed for Pros Packed with features catering to high skill play Advanced HUD showing detailed score composition and statistics Replay system allows you to analyze every swing in extreme frame-by-frame detail Minimal distractions. You can disable the environment and any effects that could distract you and hinder gaming performance Fine tune controller offsets for individual hands Fine tune map parameters such as reaction time, judgement line distance Please note: the game is in Early Access and a bunch of these features are still work in progress. Full customizability The game supports loading custom models for environments, notes, Cat Sticks(tm), etc for unlimited personalization. Designed for streaming The desktop view is optimized to be perfect for streaming or recording plays out of the box. You get a smooth wide-FOV view so that noone has to deal with jank looking gameplay. Twitch Integration is built in. You can read chat directly in-game. Future updates We are planning to add many features and improvements to the game during Early Access, such as: Graphical improvements Better controller offset system Proper tutorial Rhythm scoring mode Challenge level system Better menus and leaderboards Fitness tracking and heart rate monitor support Full body tracked in-game avatars More customization options More counters and stats Song specific environments and effects Improvements to streaming features, camera controls and overlays More built-in songs and maps Cat improvements Replay system improvements Practice system Ranked system improvements And more! Optimization at the Core We are building this game on a brand new game engine with one goal: To be the most optimized VR game ever made. We are going to extreme lengths no-one else has to ensure the game never drops a single frame during hours of gameplay. The code path for every single frame and situation has been meticulously designed to avoid frame time spikes, and multiple CPU cores are utilized in a smart way. Please note that the game is in Early Access and not fully optimized yet. Did we mention the game has a cat in it? Honestly this is the real main selling point. Please note though that the game is in Early Access and the cat is work in progress.
row.short_description: swingmania is a note slicing VR rhythm game focused at competitive ranked play, customizability, ultra high performance and cats!

row.name: Riftcast
row.detailed_description: Discover the realm of Reveria, a wild world a cast of curious creatures call home. Take the role as one of these monsters as you encounter all kinds of Reverians, and embark on all sorts of adventures and quests! ⭐ PLAY YOUR WAY Customise your experience with two versions in Red and Blue, with exclusive and more easily accessible areas, homelands, species and shells, real time progression toggles and two distinct gameplay modes... ⭐ GO EASY, GO HARD In Revery Mode, you're free to tame and nurture your currently active Reverian in one of 10 distinct homelands, while Gazing Mode presents a more challenging experience with requiring regular check-ins to maintain your whole team's well-being all at once - all while playing as the very weakest Reverians. ⭐ MEET THE REVERIANS Play as one of over 50 fully-evolved Reverians in Revery Mode (or 5 special Reverians in Gazing Mode), and encounter over 100 species and discover their unique traits and needs, from dietary needs and instinctual habits to elemental skills and special abilities. Recruit and raise up to 20 party members through adoption, dropped eggs and defeating invaders! ⭐RAISE YOUR REVERIANS Keep your party in top form by feeding, training and tending to their needs. Spend quality time with your party members by playing minigames and fighting alongside them, and watch bonds form as they hang out amongst each other... but watch out for infighting, truancy and sabotage! ⭐ COMPETE IN BATTLES Fight with your party members or enter the fray with your own player character in classic turn-based bouts. Test your skills in Training Battles, participate in Tourneys, and undertake daring Nightward Raids against waves of adversaries! ⭐ EXPLORE THE WORLD Visit your homeland for items, amenities and quests, and send off party members to search for materials and work for money and experience. Discover new areas to explore in as you increase your Player Rank with quests and raids! ⭐ COLLECT, CULTIVATE AND CRAFT Manage your inventory wisely and stock up on essential supplies from your homeland's shops and the elusive Alterworks Depot. Harvest plants, go on a voyage for materials, craft your own items and cook new foods with the help of your party members! ✨ FEATURING 135 species currently available 83 zones of differing continents and biomes to explore 50 tourneys to take on 12 minigames for training and bonding 11 homelands with exclusive items 6 quest types involving battles and item/egg deliveries Over 300 obtainable items, materials and foods Forever free! 💫 PLEASE NOTE This game's still in active development, and certain features, items and the like that are already visible or available don't do anything as of yet. There are also some differences between Red and Blue versions, such as how often certain species appear and what areas are readily available or temporary, but exclusive content isn't totally inaccessible on one or the other.
row.short_description: A cyber companion for your desktop inspired by LCD virtual pets of old. Collect, train and fight all sorts of Reverians as you take on daring ventures, fun mini-games and fierce battles.

row.name: Crazy World of Caleb-Level 1 to 7
row.detailed_description: Get Crazy Wolrd of Caleb If you like this game and want to support the developer, please consider buying the full game. About the Game Crazy World of Caleb Level 1 to 7 is just the start of the Journey. The whole experience available in Crazy World of Caleb. Here you experience Levels 1 to 7. In Crazy World of Caleb you have up to Level 38 and you also get access to Steam Achievements. NOTE : THE GAME HAS PERMA-DEATH. IF YOU LOOSE ALL YOUR LIVES, YOUR PROGRESS IS LOST AND YOU START AGAIN.
row.short_description: Experience the start of Caleb's difficult journey. For more get Crazy World of Caleb.

row.name: Shadow of Pharos
row.detailed_description: Shadow of Pharos is a short first-person horror game. The game aims to be a fully immersive experience and has no UI by default. To enable accessibility options and general settings, input the following command using the keyboard arrow keys or the controller D-Pad: left, right, left, right, down, down The menu will then be accessible by pressing ESC on the keyboard or Back/Share on a controller. Default Controls: Movement: WASD on keyboard | Left Analog on controller Look Around: Mouse | Right Analog on controller Interact: E on keyboard | Cross/A on controller Flashlight: F on keyboard | Square/X on controller Notes: Tab on keyboard | Options/Start on controller Disclaimer: The game's soundtrack was made specifically for the game, and is safe to play on videos/stream. It's also available for free on TeamGaivot's YouTube channel. If you enjoyed the game, consider supporting the team by purchasing the soundtrack here on Steam and wishlisting our next game Pharos.
row.short_description: Shadow of Pharos is a short first-person horror game.

row.name: Birdcage: A Tale of Sorrow
row.detailed_description: Birdcage is a first-person graphic adventure inspired by the classics of this genre . You have just committed a robbery and, fleeing from the police, you hide in the apartment of a mysterious woman. Through exploration, solving puzzles, and unravelling riddles, you must earn her trust to help you escape. As you uncover her past, you will see that not everything is as it seemed at first. Being aware of her situation, you will have to make decisions that will affect both your future and hers. Will you manage to escape the house? Which path will you follow? Birdcage is structured into six chapters that take place in a setting divided into various rooms. As you progress, new spaces will be unlocked. This graphic adventure aims for a fully immersive experience, featuring a first-person protagonist. All the player's decisions directly affect them and can alter the game's ending, enhancing replayability.
row.short_description: After a robbery, you find yourself trapped in a stranger's apartment and must escape without being seen by the police. To do this, you will need to gain the help of its strange resident and unravel the mysteries surrounding her.

row.name: DOUGH: A Crime Strategy RPG Playtest
End The World
row.detailed_description: Bring the End of the World in this story-driven retro title about love and hate, light and dark, and all the ways everything could end in a snap. Play as multiple characters as you traverse the Kingdom of Ionis trying to put an end to tyranny by any means possible. Keep Your Promise You are a priest of the Kingdom of Ionis – the beacon of light in the world – and you have been pushed over the edge. The end of the world is at your fingertips, but there is one who must pay by your hands before the world blinks out of existence. Be consumed by this retro adventure game about romance, heartbreak, and death. Burn In Oblivion Engage with this dark, layered story using a two-button interface just like with the first handheld games of the 1990s. With pitch-perfect music that captures the darkest games of the era, End the World will bring you to the edge of oblivion in the search for a reason to keep holding on for every single moment! Lose yourself in the pain, the romance, and the thirst for revenge, all in the name of ending the world! Don't forget to check out another unforgettable gaming experience from SimpleShutIn Productions !
row.short_description: Traverse the kingdom looking for a way to End The World for all that it's cost you.
row.notes: There are references to self-harm, lost pregnancies, and genocide.

row.name: Jigs4w3D Puzzle Challenge
row.detailed_description: Jigs4w3D Puzzle Challenge is a casual, relaxing, family-friendly 3D puzzle game. Chill, enjoy the immersive 3D environments and complete a fine selection of your favourite puzzles. Replay value is guaranteed as you can choose from different categories and solve all 31 puzzles on 5 difficulty settings for completely free. If you wish for more, grab your favourite DLC from the store! Features 31 free puzzles additional weekly puzzles and updates 5 difficulties for each puzzle 2 free, atmospheric environments Living Room Cosy Bedroom 100 achievements additional achievements for future puzzles will be added 10 relaxing music tracks enhanced camera movement find small details easily made in Unreal Engine 5 cozy, realistic, colorful and immersive full 3D environments real-time physics, powered by Chaos Physics light-weight physics simulation solution used in Fortnite
row.short_description: Jigs4w3D Puzzle Challenge is a casual single-player experience. Chill, enjoy the immersive 3D environments and complete a fine selection of your favourite puzzles. Choose from different categories and solve all 31 puzzles on 5 difficulty settings for completely free or grab your favourite DLC.

row.name: Lost Girl Platformer
row.detailed_description: Lost Girl Platformer is a thrilling 2D platform game where you play as a courageous girl. Your task is to jump from platform to platform to survive and escape. But be careful: time is limited, and every jump must be precise! Features: - Pixel graphics - Obstacle courses - Timer Good luck!
row.short_description: Lost Girl Platformer is a thrilling 2D platform game where you play as a courageous girl. Your task is to jump from platform to platform to survive and escape. But be careful: time is limited, and every jump must be precise!

row.name: Oil and Sand
row.detailed_description: An exciting tower defense game where you have to defend your island from the invasion of enemy forces. Your task is to build and upgrade towers to repel waves of attacking enemies. Become a true commander, place defensive structures on the island, and don't let enemies penetrate the territory! Your strategic thinking and ability to effectively use resources will be key in this struggle for survival. Features: - 3D Graphics - Five types of towers: You have access to five different types of towers for defense. Each tower has its own unique characteristics. Choose wisely to effectively deal with enemies. - Variety of enemies: A variety of enemies await you in the game. - Strategic thinking: Place towers so that they cover the most vulnerable points of the island and effectively restrain enemies.
row.short_description: An exciting tower defense game where you have to defend your island from the invasion of enemy forces. Your task is to build and upgrade towers to repel waves of attacking enemies.

row.name: A Work of Art
row.detailed_description: A Work of Art A Work of Art can be described as a dark and witty psychological thriller in the horror genre. Players can expect a 1-2 hour story-driven experience, featuring a mix of Visual Novel and traditional RPG elements. Follow a colorful cast of quirky characters through a twisting tale of beauty and darkness; All to a masterfully dark Original Soundtrack. Features: Player - Developer interaction. An opportunity to be selected to choose the name of a character for future episodes as a token of our gratitude for your support. An atmospheric, psychological horror experience that will strap you to an emotional rollercoaster with no brakes. Wonderful Soundtrack by A Beautiful Collection of Darkness Uncover dark secrets far beyond what you'd suspect... FREE! ♥ (I mean, why not, right? What's the worst that can happen? ) ...
row.short_description: A dark, witty, psychological thriller in the horror genre, A Work of Art presents a 1-2 hour story-driven experience with Visual Novel features and RPG elements. Follow a colorful cast of quirky characters through a twisted tale of beauty and darkness; All to the sound of a Dark Original soundtrack.
row.notes: This game may contain references to death, self-harm, harm to others, violence, gore, torture, and other mature themes. This game also may contain puppy dogs, just in case you're allergic or something... ♥

row.name: Nexus Rumble: The Ultimate Showdown
row.detailed_description: Survive, Conquer, and Dominate in Nexus Rumble – The Ultimate Multiplayer Battle Royale Experience! Dive into fast-paced, adrenaline-fueled battles where 30 players clash in dynamic, ever-changing arenas. Whether you're a fan of strategic survival, chaotic party games, or skill-based combat, Nexus Rumble delivers non-stop action across diverse maps and unique game modes. Will you outsmart, outrun, and outlast your rivals to claim victory? Be the last one standing Gather your friends or face off against worthy adversaries as you fight tooth and nail to be the last one standing. With multiple rounds of intense action, strategic gameplay, and unexpected twists, Nexus Rumble keeps you on the edge of your seat until the very end. Do you have what it takes to outwit, outmaneuver, and outlast your opponents? Step into the Nexus Rumble arena and prove your mettle as the ultimate champion! Victory awaits those who dare to seize it in this electrifying test of skill, speed, and survival. Are you ready to rumble? Key Features to Fuel Your Competitive Spirit: 30-Player Mayhem : Compete in large-scale, heart-pounding battles where only the strongest survive. Endless Variety : Master tons of   unique game modes – from explosive Bomb Tag to sword-clashing duels – each with strategic twists. Custom Lobbies : Play with friends or rivals in private matches or join public showdowns for global glory.  Dynamic Maps : Navigate treacherous terrain, dodge crumbling tiles, and sprint through high-stakes racecourses. Cross-Platform Play : Battle players worldwide on any device (PC / Mobile). Customizable Character: Stand out in the arena by customizing your avatar with hats, glasses, mustaches, and a variety of color options for hair, eyes, skin, and outfits. Game Modes Designed for Maximum Thrills: Experience an array of electrifying game modes in this battle royale, each with its own unique challenges: Bomb Tag : Pass the ticking bomb in this chaotic party game – one wrong move and BOOM! Stick Tag: Dodge the tag stick—tag others and pass it on before time's up! Sword Fight : Prove your melee mastery in free-for-all clashes. Race : Speed through obstacle-packed courses in a fast-paced dash for survival. Tile Puzzle : Find the hidden path before the clock – and the tiles – crack under pressure! Stepping Stone : Test your nerve on rigged stones – one misstep means elimination! Mingle: Quickly form groups of the required size in a room or face elimination. Red Light Green Light: Freeze on red, move on green—beat the clock to survive! Football: Smash the giant football with your stick, team up, and dominate to score! Jump Rush: Leap over the rotating cylinder—nail your timing or tumble off Are you ready to rumble? Prove your mettle in Nexus Rumble —the ultimate multiplayer battle royale experience!
row.short_description: Welcome to Nexus Rumble, the ultimate showdown where champions clash in a fierce competition for survival! Prepare to embark on an adrenaline-fueled journey through diverse landscapes and exhilarating challenges in this heart-pounding multiplayer extravaganza.

row.name: Qazaq: Son of the Sun
row.detailed_description: Adventure through the Ancient Lands of Kazakhstan As the last Qazaq, saved by the Sun God, you must restore light and warmth to your homeland by defeating the evil spirit Shaitan. Explore the open world of Kazakhstan in the twilight and ignite the totems of all the tribes. Shaitan himself will mock you, lead you astray, and summon dark spirits. The power of the Sun will help you find the path to your ancestors and stand against Shaitan. Game Features: Stylized open world. Pleasant nighttime atmosphere. Interactive storytelling about Qazaq tribes. Minimal interface for maximum immersion. Simple totem puzzles. Immortal player, enemies only deal debuffs. Note: This game is perfect for people with limited time for gaming, seeking a simple and relaxing gameplay experience, as well as for newcomers to gaming due to its accessibility.
row.short_description: Qazaq: Son of the Sun - a single-player first-person open-world game with puzzles set in Kazakhstan, where you are the last surviving Qazaq saved by the Sun God.

row.name: One Paradox
row.detailed_description: Year 2080. Humanity managed to achieve the SDGs of the 2030 Agenda, thanks to the artificial intelligence created by UN computer scientists! Now androids are in charge of ecological production systems and taking care of the planet. Or are they? A first person narrative adventure set in a distopic future. Advance trough the futuristic factory OF-1, solve puzzles, evade the other androids and uncover its hidden secrets. Your role as an android of the R06-ER series, on your first day as a worker at The Factory, is to preserve the well-being and prosperity of planet Earth. You are programmed to follow the protocol and instructions of the supervising AI and will go from room to room, completing assigned tasks. If you see strange messages or signs, ignore them; the new update is causing issues and some androids may malfunction. Just follow the protocol, complete your shift, and a comforting oil bath awaits you! A good Roger follows orders! Features: Explore a futuristic environment with synthwave aesthetics: Immerse yourself in a vibrant, retro-futuristic world that combines visual elements of synthwave. Dubbed in Catalan, with a retrowave soundtrack: Enjoy a fully immersive experience with Catalan voiceovers and a soundtrack that evokes the retrowave style. First-person narrative experience: Live the story from your character’s perspective, feeling like a part of the game world. Learn about sustainability and ethics in ecological production: Through the narrative, discover the importance of sustainable and ethical practices in production. Complete tasks assigned by the factory’s AI: Solve puzzles and explore different areas of the factory while following the instructions of the supervising AI.
row.short_description: A first-person narrative adventure set in a dystopian future. Advance through the futuristic OF-1 factory, solve puzzles, evade other androids, and uncover its hidden secrets.

row.name: Forgotten Fears
row.detailed_description: Experience five different levels: Forest: You are a forest keeper. Your task is to bring light to the forest while avoiding danger lurking in the dark. You have your trusty flashlight and a map that will guide your way, but be careful, as the flashlight battery is limited . Light all the lamps marked on the map to provide safety for yourself and the forest. Underwater: After an accident, you wake up underwater in a small cage and quickly realize, that you are not alone . You must find several items that will help you. Explore the cage quietly, so you don't disturb the danger , and find the items before you run out of oxygen. Cottage: After a long drive, you have finally arrived at an abandoned cottage with paranormal activity. Find the way to open the basement door . Explore the house, find hidden objects, solve puzzles, unlock blocked areas , and take what belongs to you. But be careful, as you are not alone . You have your flashlight to help you out. UNKNOWN: You are in the UNKNOWN place, there is no light, no day, no night, no exit. Find and pull 10 levers to open the escape from this place . Avoid the traps and the danger lurking in the dark . You can find different monitors in the labyrinth, some of them will show you how much time is left, how many levers you have to pull, and also the minimap to orient yourself. Basement: You've got your first job as an 'Anomaly Huntsman'. You arrived at the place and quickly got to work. You have a computer to monitor and report anomalies. The first few hours were quite silent, but as the night progressed anomalies started appearing faster and faster, sometimes even appearing in your room. Use your computer to fix anomalies and environment to stay safe from anomalies that occur in your room.
row.short_description: Forgotten Fears is a collection of five small horror games, ranging from rainy forest to deep underwater.
row.notes: This Game may contain content not appropriate for all ages, or may not be appropriate for viewing at work: violence and blood.

row.name: Battlefield™ REDSEC
row.detailed_description: Season 1 hits Southern California. Play now. All-Out Warfare descends on Southern California. Season 1 rolls out in 3 phases: first with Rogue Ops, then California Resistance, and Winter Offensive, each packed with thematic classified military hardware, cutting-edge gadgets, new maps, and weapons of unprecedented power. Every month new content is added, and is immediately available for near-limitless customization in Portal. About the Game Now entering REDSEC, a free-to-play destination built on Battlefield’s iconic DNA. Drop into Fort Lyndon for a Battle Royale only Battlefield can deliver, featuring massive-scale destruction, fast-paced squad play, and the deadliest ring in BR. Survive and advance in Gauntlet: an all-new cutthroat, knockout-style elimination mode where squads race to complete missions. Then redraw the lines of battle with Portal. Play free now. A fight for secrets is raging in Fort Lyndon. This massive, redacted military facility hidden in plain sight between pristine beaches and a sleepy residential community is home to some of the most advanced military projects in the world. Rogue operators are racing against time and hostiles to keep each other out and the secrets in. Drop into a Battle Royale only Battlefield can deliver, featuring massive-scale destruction, fast-paced squad play, and the deadliest ring in BR. The power of Tactical Destruction brings an explosive new layer of depth to Battle Royale. Blast open pathways and demolish enemy positions for a strategic advantage. Survive and advance in Gauntlet: an all-new cutthroat, knockout-style elimination mode where squads race to complete missions. REDSEC gives unprecedented access to Portal’s massive sandbox. Every player has the ability to create unique and unforgettable experiences, for free. This game includes optional in-game purchases of virtual currency that can be used to acquire virtual in-game items.
row.short_description: Now entering REDSEC, the ultimate free-to-play FPS destination built on Battlefield’s iconic DNA. Featuring Battle Royale, Gauntlet, & the power of Portal.

row.name: Hidden Cats - Pirates
row.detailed_description: Dive into the enchanting world of 'Hidden Cats - Pirates' a hidden object game where your mission is to uncover every cat hidden within stunning hand-painted artwork. Let your keen eye and curiosity guide you through this captivating journey. ※ Key Features: 😺 100 Hidden Cats: Discover 100 hidden cats scattered throughout the artwork. 💡 Unlimited Hints: Stuck? Use unlimited hints to find the hidden cats and keep progressing. 🎵 Custom Music: Enjoy unique background music for the artwork, enhancing your immersion. 🕒 Timer: Keep track of how long you take to complete the level with an in-game timer. 🏅 Leaderboard: Track your best times and challenge yourself to beat them. ※ Controls: Navigate the scenes using your mouse to drag and move, and zoom in/out with your mouse wheel. Click on any cat you find to collect it. ※ Accessibility Features: Night Mode for comfortable viewing Join us in 'Hidden Cats - Pirates' and indulge in the perfect blend of challenge, charm, and discovery. Will you find all the hidden cats? Let the hunt begin!
row.short_description: Dive into the enchanting world of 'Hidden Cats - Pirates' a hidden object game where your mission is to uncover every cat hidden within stunning hand-painted artwork. Let your keen eye and curiosity guide you through this captivating journey.

row.name: City find all
row.detailed_description: City find all is an exciting puzzle game for finding objects in a cozy town. This game is a great way to relax after a hard day and get away from problems. Intuitive gameplay and a calm atmosphere does not bother the player and allows you to immediately immerse yourself in the process. Melodious light music creates an atmosphere of tranquility and mystery in the game. Some items will be easier to find. And some items will have to work hard to find! There are many objects on the location, there are numerous buildings, benches, signs, and other urban decorations. The player must explore every part of the location to find the necessary items.
row.short_description: City find all is an exciting 3D puzzle game for finding objects in a cozy town. There are many objects on the location, there are numerous buildings, benches, signs, and other urban decorations. The player must explore every part of the location to find the necessary items.

row.name: Medival Hustle
row.detailed_description: In this captivating 3D medival-quest game, you will immerse yourself in a world of fantasy landscapes, where every hill and castle hides its own secrets and adventures. Features: - Open World: You will find yourself in a vast world where you can move freely. - Quests and Missions: Exciting quests await you, which will diversify your gaming experience. From searching for ancient artifacts to rescuing people. - Hills and Castles Travel through green hills, where picturesque views and hidden caves await you. - Colorful Graphics The visual perception of the game is a true work of art.
row.short_description: Madival Hustle is a captivating 3D medival-quest game, where you will immerse yourself in a world of fantasy landscapes, where every hill and castle hides its own secrets and adventures. Follow the storyline completing the quests and find out what awaits you in the finale.

row.name: FreakShow
row.detailed_description: Welcome to the arena! Are you strong enough for the FreakShow? Well... unfortunately you do not have a choice, be the victor or die trying! The FreakShow is a game show set in a post apocalyptic world. A Team of 3 Players battles enemy team for glory and wealth Smile! You are on camera... and the Jumbotron!! Live Announcer! You have to learn to be STRATEGIC in the arena: Figure out the balance of managing your own zombie horde and fighting along side them! Place defenses to protect your own base from the enemy! Work together as a team to DEMOLISH your opponents! Surviving in FreakShow is about more than just brute force; it requires strategy, stealth, and well timed attacks.
row.short_description: Welcome to the FreakShow! A twisted mix of FPS and tower defense set in the aftermath of an apocalypse where post-modern gladiatorial combat, an ever-changing arena, and your own zombies all meet in a chaotic team vs team showdown! Will you survive the arena?
row.notes: There is violence and a little of blood splatter when the zombies and players are hit.

row.name: Neon Fever
row.detailed_description: Neon Fever is a 4v4 action arena shooter, with a single weapon: the laser rifle. Use modules to enhance your shots, gadgets to gain new abilities and fight to the death for your team's honor! Two teams - the Beam Boys and the Laser Lads - compete to be the first to reach 3000 points. Gain points by killing enemy players or by participating in dynamic game modes like King Of The Hill - where your team has to stand its ground in an exposed location - or Chicken Run - where players must catch and hold onto the chicken for a looong time while avoiding enemy shots. Games last for 10 to 15 minutes and don't leave any time to breath, with a high octane rhythm and high stakes all the way through to the end. The game keeps track of your match history and stats just so you can flex your KD to your friends! Neon Fever is the first, best, greatest and only game of the Beam Boys team, created as our final group project for the DDJV program at the University of Sherbrooke (2023-2024). The Beam Boys are (by order of last name): Albin Calais Narvin Chana Martin Dufour Alexandre Lemarbre-Barrett Merlin Roudier Joshua Van Hollebeke And thanks to Vincent Lévêque for the awesome soundtrack! All asset licenses can be found in the game files, but most were created by us during development.
row.short_description: Jump, slide and shoot! Kill a player or wipe the entire enemy team with your one-shot-no-scope-super-laser-aiming skills and use gadgets to your advantage, in a 4v4 arena shooter with dynamic game modes and fast paced movement mechanics. May the better team win!

row.name: Gunship Battle Total Warfare
row.detailed_description: Gunship Battle: Total Warfare, a hit modern military strategy game with over 10 million downloads, offers the perfect blend of strategy, intense combat, and an immersive, unique environment. Reclaim and fortify your base, build and upgrade iconic modern military units—ships, jets, and tanks—each designed with real-world precision and power. Immerse yourself in a gripping narrative set in a drowned world where the last survivors fight for dominance and survival. Key Features: -  Legendary Military Units:   Strengthen, upgrade, and deploy real-world inspired ships, jets, and tanks, to enhance their unique abilities, firepower, and capabilities in combat. -  PvE Features: Battle powerful enemy fleets and squadrons to conquer new territories. -  PvP Features: Enjoy competitive and casual PvP battles, offering challenges for both casual players and hardcore military enthusiasts. -  Alliance Power: Form powerful alliances with other Admirals, coordinating strikes, defending territory, and pushing back against the tide of invasion. -  Mini-Games for Extra Action : Enjoy action-packed mini-games that offer a change of pace:    - Fortress: Test your strategic mind and tactical skills in this tower defense mini-game.    - Sky Ace: Strap into the cockpit and take to the skies in this arcade-inspired jet mini-game.
row.short_description: In a post-apocalyptic world submerged by the sea, the wake of the enemy is apparent at every turn. From turning the tides of naval warfare to dominating the skies in break-neck aerial combat, every decision you make will change the outcome of the battle.

row.name: Groovy Labs
row.detailed_description: Groovy Labs is an open and cross-platform sandbox for rhythm games in Virtual and Mixed Reality (VR/XR). It’s powered by a database of over 100 000 community-made song beatmaps for Beat Saber. Groovy Labs aims to become something more than Beat Saber though, by providing a platform for immersive experiences rather than being a single game. A platform for music and rhythm-based mini-games, powered by content created by us, the community of players . One of the biggest selling points of Groovy Labs is the sheer number and variety of songs the players can choose from. There's tens of thousands of beatmaps (levels) created by Beat Saber community that we tap into. Groovy Labs is highly customizable to cater to various players preferences. This includes the ability to choose the type of gameplay, an environment in which the game takes place, custom models of weapons and destructible objects and more. The customizations described above are part of what makes Groovy Labs an extensible platform . The content that the community creates may even introduce novel gameplay mechanics that we haven't yet thought of. This approach is similar to other, highly popular and profitable platforms, like Fortnite, Minecraft or Roblox. Groovy Labs is available on the following platforms: SteamVR, Meta Quest, PICO, Apple Vision Pro, SideQuest.
row.short_description: Groovy Labs is an open and cross-platform sandbox for rhythm games in Virtual and Mixed Reality (VR/XR). It’s powered by a database of over 100 000 community-made song beatmaps.

row.name: Last Command: Prologue
row.detailed_description: Play the full game In "Last Command: Prologue" , you can experience the special prologue chapter of the Last Command About the Game In 'Last Command: Prologue' , you can experience the special prologue chapter of the Last Command, an bullet-hell, boss-rush adventure RPG that inspired from the classic Snake game! Embark on a Journey in an digital world, the final phase of the mankind's evolution, where the sentients program who used to served human live, laugh, and... Snake x Bullet Hell = A New Take on the Classic Experience! Grease up your arrow keys and stretch your fingers! Maneuver the Crawler through the enemies’ barrage of attacks and collect Data Points to deal damage! Gain special chips to enhance the Crawler as you progress, overcome intense Boss battles, and uncover the secrets of their program world... ▉ 'Last Command' takes inspiration from the classic game 'Snake,' but adds two additional actions, 'Dash' and 'Analyze.' Make good use of these new actions to dodge attacks and collect 'Data' generated in the levels to inflict damage. ▉There are numerous, non-repetitive battles, each with their own unique style and attack pattern ranging from dazzling screen filling barrages to obstacles that wish to overwhelm you. Each one will be a test to your ability to respond to various difficulties. ▉Modules can be found throughout the game and grant a variety of special abilities. Combined together, they can create a 'Resonance Effect,' granting unique and stronger bonuses. Find the best combination for your playstyle! ▉Overcome dangers and challenges while uncovering long-forgotten secrets left after the disappearance of humans as you explore the vast world of programs.
row.short_description: Last Command is a fast-paced Snake x Bullet Hell action game. Maneuver through enemies’ barrage of attacks, collect Data Points to deal damage! Mix and match skill chips as you progress, overcome intense Boss battles, and uncover the secrets of their program world...

row.name: Monster Commanders
row.detailed_description: Defeating isn’t the only answer. Imagination creates allies—and weaves the story itself. Monster Commanders: Nocturne of the Abyss is a groundbreaking turn-based strategy game where you battle using AI and your own words. You take command as a Monster Tamer , issuing creative prompts to guide your monsters through the battlefield. ◆ AI × Free Text Input × Tactical Battles Every action in combat is controlled by your own written prompts . Whether you slash with a sword, cast a buffing ritual, or persuade enemies to join your side— your imagination shapes the battle. A powerful language model (LLM) interprets your commands and narrates the combat like a story. You're not just choosing skills— you’re crafting sentences . Your words become orders , and those orders bring your monsters to life. ◆ A New Kind of Collection: AI-Generated Monsters In this world, monsters aren't found—they’re generated . Spend in-game currency to obtain randomly generated monsters Use premium items to create fully original monsters , with AI-generated appearances and abilities Each monster is a unique companion, born from your experience. Who you meet and who you recruit—your personal collection will naturally grow into something one of a kind. ◆ Build Your Party. Shape the Battlefield. Form a party of your AI-generated monsters and dive into tactical quests. Every monster has unique roles and traits Tailor your commands with prompts based on the situation AI interprets your orders and dynamically changes the outcome of battle Every fight is narrated as your own personal story You are the Tamer. A strategist who commands with words. ◆ A World of Quests and Creation Accept official quests or dive into original ones crafted by other players via the Hunt Board , updated regularly in-game. Earn rewards and generate new monsters to keep expanding your legend.
row.short_description: Beyond the Battle Lies the Unexpected—Victory isn’t always about conquest.Negotiate, reconcile, fight side by side... even marry!?Unpredictable quests unfold based on your choices.

row.name: Halmaverse
row.detailed_description: Halmaverse is a board game for 2 or 4 players where the goal is to move your pieces to the opposite corner of the board. The player who moves their pieces to the corner first wins the game. The classic Halma game mode allows pieces to move one step in any direction per turn, or to jump over one or multiple pieces in a row. In Battle Halma, players can also pick up randomly generated power-ups that allows additional movements and actions. Choose between 2 types of boards and 5 types of pieces with different materials.

row.name: Number Fields
row.detailed_description: Overview: Number Fields is a strategic puzzle game where your goal is to uncover all tiles on the grid without triggering hidden bombs. Use logical deduction and visual cues to navigate the fields, uncover treasures, and mark suspected bomb locations with flags. Perfect for fans of classic puzzle games who enjoy a mix of strategy and luck, this game was designed to keep you fully engaged during long meetings or customer interactions while discreetly calming nervous energy. It avoids sudden sounds and flashy colors to ensure it doesn't draw attention. There is nothing 'extra' or flashy about this game. It doesn't aim to be dramatic or the center of attention. It's simply a tool to help you stay sane during those moments when you feel like you're living an episode of 'The Office' but need to keep your job. Key Features: - Zoom Meeting Friendly: No sudden sounds, no surprise flashing colors, and no forced full-screen mode. This game is perfect for playing during long meetings without drawing attention. - Insomnia Friendly: Low blue-light, no eye-burning colors, or ear-splitting sounds. A perfect mix of distraction and calm logic, pairing well with the music you need to sleep. - Challenging Gameplay: Uncover tiles to reveal numbers and colors indicating the proximity of hidden bombs and treasures. - Visual Cues: Numbers indicate the proximity of bombs, while colors indicate the proximity to treasures, adding a visual layer of strategy. - Flagging System: Right-click to mark suspected bomb locations, helping you keep track of dangerous spots. - Dynamic Scoring: Earn points by uncovering treasures and correctly flagging bombs. - Adjustable Difficulty: Choose between easy, medium, and hard modes to match your skill level. - Grid Customization: Adjust the grid size using the slider, ranging from small grids for quick games to large grids for a more challenging experience. - Satisfying Endgame: Enjoy dynamic endgame animations that highlight your flagged points with smooth scaling effects. - Intuitive Controls: Simple left-click to reveal tiles and right-click to place or remove flags. Gameplay Mechanics: 1. Revealing Tiles: - Left-click on a tile to reveal it. - Numbers indicate the presence of adjacent bombs and treasures. - If a tile contains a bomb, the game ends. - If a tile contains a treasure, you earn points. 2. Flagging Tiles: - Right-click to place a flag on suspected bomb locations. - Right-click again to remove the flag. - Flags help you keep track of potential bomb spots. 3. Winning the Game: - Win by revealing all non-bomb tiles. - The game ends when all non-bomb tiles are revealed or if a bomb tile is uncovered. Design: Number Fields features a clean, intuitive design that enhances the puzzle-solving experience. The game uses muted colors for visual cues, making it easy to distinguish between different elements. The scaling effects and animations during gameplay provide a satisfying and engaging experience. Get ready to test your logic and deduction skills in Number Fields – a puzzle game that combines strategy, excitement, and a touch of luck. Will you uncover all the tiles and find the treasures, or will you trigger a bomb and end the game? Play now and find out!
row.short_description: Number Fields is a logic game where players uncover tiles indicating the proximity of hidden bombs and treasures. Choose your difficulty, customize grid sizes, and enjoy. Provides a way to stay fully engaged while calming nervous energy discreetly.

row.name: Burning Sky

row.name: Mushiverse - Online Boardgame
row.detailed_description: Mushiverse is an online board game that can be played with 4 to 6 players. With its unique characters, villages, and mechanics, it offers you a one-of-a-kind experience. You can easily defeat your opponents with customized characters. You can either pay less rent to get ahead, or you can throw your opponents in jail and sabotage them to reach the peak of fun. You can annoy your opponents by being a character that goes against the rules of the game. When you select an opponent during the game, you steal their village and character. In the Mushiverse universe, each village has its own unique features. By choosing a village, you select your teammates and determine your strategy. Earthquake Mechanics A randomly selected city is declared as the earthquake city. The rent multiplier of the earthquake city increases! Attention! You might want to invest in this city, but an earthquake could happen at any moment! Lover Cities Two randomly selected cities fall in love with each other. Any action you take in one love-struck city will automatically be reflected in the other! Farm System If you have at least one house on every property you purchase, you will start earning passive income from that property.
row.short_description: Mushiverse is an Online Board Game that can be played with 4-6 friends. It offers a unique experience with its diverse mechanics. Each player starts the game with unique characters and aims to reach the targeted number of flags by navigating various risks and luck factors.

Your friends are nowhere to be found, and an eerie silence fills the air. Gameplay: Navigate the Woods: Traverse through the dense forest to reach the cabin. Beware of hidden dangers lurking in the shadows. Investigate the Campsite: Explore the campsite and surrounding areas to uncover clues about what happened to your friends. Make Critical Choices: Decide whether to stay and search for your friends or find the keys to the truck and make a quick escape. Features: Multiple endings based on your choices. An immersive plot that keeps you on the edge of your seat. Thank you for playing. Your feedback is invaluable as we work towards creating the full version of the game.

row.name: My Sudoku

Try the simpler 4x4 and 6x6 puzzles if you're just starting out, or go straight to the 9x9 puzzles for a classic Sudoku challenge. Solve Sudoku puzzles to earn achievements and unlock even more puzzles. Save and load your games to continue playing Sudoku at your leisure. Enjoy a relaxed lo-fi soundtrack, which provides the perfect soundscape for a chilled-out puzzling experience. Start your Sudoku adventure with a selection of free puzzles, expanding the game with DLC when you're ready for more. Are you ready to start solving? Let's play My Sudoku!
row.short_description: Beginners, casual players and experts will find an enjoyable challenge in My Sudoku. Solve puzzles at your own pace in a pleasant and relaxing atmosphere.

Stock Ordering and Management Purchase your stocks, organize their placement, and transfer them from crates to stalls. Remember, fruits and vegetables start to spoil over time. Interactive Sales Experience Assist customers in their selections and manage payments both in cash and via QR code or IBAN. Ensure every customer leaves satisfied, creating repeat customers and a lively market atmosphere. Adapt to Market Fluctuations Buy products when prices are low and set competitive sales prices in the dynamic market environment. row.short_description: Bring the traditional market experience to the modern world! Arrange vegetables and fruits on stalls and fulfill customer orders. Set prices, hire staff, and expand your market. Online orders, home delivery, and much more coming soon.

row.name: Bounce Ball
row.detailed_description: Bounce Ball is a casual 2D puzzle platformer where your goal is to create platforms to bounce the ball into the goal. Put your skills and creativity to the test with 100 different levels. Collect stars along the way and complete various achievements to unlock an array of cosmetics, allowing you to customize your game's experience.
row.short_description: In this casual 2D puzzle platformer, create multiple platforms to bounce the ball into the goal.

row.name: Dark Chronicles:Reawakening of Evil
row.detailed_description: 'Dark Chronicles:Reawakening of Evil' is a survivor-like game that features no complex equipment combinations, intricate maps, or complicated items. It allows you to jump right in and play anytime. Through agile controls, you can engage in intense combat and truly enjoy the game. Each chapter consists of multiple mini-maps, where you must face hordes of demons swarming from all directions. Your goal is to unleash relentless attacks and eliminate all demons. Survive for 60 seconds to obtain temporary cards that boost defense or attack, then continue exploring other mini-maps until you locate the one with the BOSS. Defeat the BOSS to earn a treasure chest, which contains powerful weapons and equipment when opened. This intense battle royale game lets you encounter countless fierce demon warriors and demon mages. Slaughter these demons and claim victory! Game Features: Wield a staff to unleash deadly magic attacks in ice, fire, and poison elements. Freely combine various skills to boost damage and add unique effects. Each skill can be upgraded to max level, advancing into an even more powerful form! Ice spells slow enemy movement, fire spells inflict massive damage, and poison spells weaken enemy defense, making them take extra damage. Craft your own art of slaughter and create a unique screen-clearing rhythm. Successfully defeat the BOSS or escape its assaults to obtain powerful equipment. Each equipment piece can be upgraded, with every level enhancing defense or attack for a leap in combat power. But stay vigilant! To secure treasure chests, you must spare no effort to dodge dense demon attacks and emerge victorious! You can set the game language to English by following these steps: Click the 'Settings' icon in the upper-right corner of the game interface, then change the 'Language' option from 'Chinese (Simplified)' to 'English' in the settings window.

As anywhere else in the universe fun is in the eye of the beholder - some like to unveil the secrets of the universe, some prefer to discuss about the meaning of liff, some others like to race. Marbles as such roll. Long time ago they discovered that this can be used to race against each other. The long history of marble racing has seen many changes. There were marblathons and cross country rolls over short and long distance, they even did the Iron Marble. Short time ago someone started to put together weird tracks with ramps and such and started to roll. It didn't take long until the fun spread all over the World of Marbles. Dustbin::Games MarbleGP is a 3d Marble Racing game. Up to 16 marbles race on a variety of tracks, some including jumps, loops and moving obstacles. This game gives you the most realistic and stunning marble racing experience you have ever experienced. In principle the game is simple, it comes with just four simple rules: Rule 1: the Fastest Marble Wins Rule 2: Stay On the Track Rule 3: Expect No Mercy Rule 4: Show No Mercy Even though there are only five controls for your marble (Forward, Backward, Left, Right and Brake, plus Rearview and Manual Respawn) and controlling the marble is quite simple you will soon realize that getting the most out of the marbles and competing against the best AI marbles requires a lot of practice.

row.name: Escape from HAON ISLAND
row.detailed_description: ABOUT 'Escape from HAON ISLAND' is a first-person 3D platformer with unique controls - where you find yourself on an island with happy inhabitants and try to escape. STORY A strange voice is telling you, to escape. Afterward, you land in a crater of a mysterious Island. You soon encounter its happy inhabitants who are very friendly and positive. On your journey, you eliminate weird creatures by jumping onto them, while some others should better be avoided. By exploring you solve problems, master your jumping skill and get to know more about the island. Eventually you figure out what this whole place is about, why you are there and how you can escape. GAMEPLAY 'Escape from HAON ISLAND' is a small, simple, story driven 3D indie platformer for the PC. You play in the first-person perspective and move around by jumping and running. The key gameplay feature is to master the controls to get skilled enough to solve the jumping passages. Simple, but not easy. You can play with a keyboard & mouse or a game pad. Furthermore, you can adjust the sensitivity of the camera's movement speed to your liking. There are seven different levels. You can find a lot of collectibles in most of them. You only have one life point; if you get hit, the level will restart. There is no option to save, only checkpoints after each level. Thus, after you successfully finish a level, you might be able to find a shortcut. The game has no violence or rough, inappropriate language.

Turtle Champs
row.detailed_description: Take control of a Turtle in a game of Football in this First Person Shooter. Use your gun for movement and to shoot the ball around. Turtle Champs is an online multiplayer game where you and your friends can duke it out in the Football field to see who is the true Turtle Champion. Your weapon is your best friend. Use the pistol to either shoot the ball, launch your opponents or fly around the field at great speeds. You get 5 minutes on the clock to score more goals than your opponents. Gameplay: Play for 5 minutes to see which team can score the most goals. This game is intended to appeal to the casual audience who just want a free game to play with their online friends. Please do not take this game too seriously... it's literally Turtle Football with guns Your Weapon: For the default game mode, you are given 9 bullets for your pistol. You can shoot either 1 or 3 bullets at a time depending on what you need. Your gun only reloads while on the ground but aerial movement will let you hit the ball before your opponents. This can allow more skilled players to have an advantage over new players. The Field: There are 3 maps: Forest, Beach and Space. These maps are purely aesthetic have no difference in gameplay. The field is large as players have more range with their weapons and can move quickly. Because players have long range, there is a small goal located above the large one. This goal is a 3 pointer whereas the bottom large goal is only 1 point. While it might be difficult to hit, it can separate good players from great players. The Experience: Turtle Champs puts the players first. Though the game is recommended to be played on the Default settings, we give players the freedom of playing how they want to play. (up to 8 players is supported but we recommend no more than 4 for ping reasons) The F2P Model: Turtle Champs includes NO pay to win features. The entire game is free except for the Cosmetic Pass which is available to purchase. The Cosmetic Pass is a DLC content that can be purchased that allows players to add a topper onto their shell or change the skin of your weapon. Other players will be able to see these changes.

row.name: Fish Idle 2: Underwater Mystery
row.detailed_description: Crush in your rainboots and hop into your boat! We are going fishing in Fish Idle 2: Underwater Mystery, a unique idle fishing arcade featuring smooth graphics and intuitive mechanics. We have no time to swing a fishing rod, so let’s streamline the process! SIMPLE AND EASY FISHING Let’s start with the basics. It’s all about automation: fish start biting as soon as you approach them, and resource indicators keep you informed while you focus on managing your Fish Kingdom effectively. The game offers advantageous upgrades to enhance your idle fishing abilities, helping you become a true fish tycoon. You’ll still need to steer your boat to chase fish schools and avoid obstacles, so don’t get too distracted by your economic prowess! UPGRADE YOUR FISH KINGDOM Once your hull is full, it’s time to get upgraded! Improvements in fishing speed let you catch more and rarer species, while increased storage capacity allows you to hold more catches in your boat. Boost your boat’s speed and defense for impact protection, and enhance your fishing rods to cast multiple lines at once. It’s all about maximizing your gains in the most efficient way, so you’ll have to use your head to figure out the best way to success! MAKE IT BIG Just like in real life, becoming a fish tycoon involves various ways to profit from your catches. The Idle Fish Farm allows you to invest and get passive income, while the Black Market lets you upgrade your Fish Kingdoms beyond OSHA standards. The Bots Shop enables you to hire hunter, fisher, and cargo ships to fish and deliver catch for you, boosting your income. If day trading is your thing, there is a Currency Exchange that has some special benefits. Tax fraud is not a crime, it’s an obligation if you want to make it big. NOW GO FISH Get ready to dive into the Fish Kingdoms and become the ultimate fish tycoon in Fish Idle 2: Underwater Mystery!

Unbeknownst to him, he's being watched as he makes his way through the hood. But who’s watching him... Or what, and why? Prepare yourself for a chilling journey where the streets hide more than just gangsters. Experience the intense thrill of survival in a first-person walking and running (and screaming) simulator. Explore the gritty streets of the hood while uncovering its hidden secrets. Engage in dynamic conversations with a diverse cast of characters and navigate through eerie, atmospheric environments. Use your wits to solve puzzles, avoid deadly encounters and confront the supernatural horrors that lurk around every corner. Will you survive the night and discover the truth? Atmospheric environments Photo-realistic graphics Conversations with NPC's Thrilling storyline Spine-chilling audio design
row.short_description: Mason is assigned a new job from the big boss when strange things start happening and he discovers the true meaning of fear... Horror in Da Hood is a gripping first-person horror game set in the hood, where the supernatural lurks around every corner. Are you brave enough to face the real terror?
row.notes: Our game contains content that may be suitable for mature audiences. There are mild depictions of blood and the presence of a supernatural being.

row.name: WGV: Dreamcatcher
row.detailed_description: This is a free unofficial fan-game. In this game, you play as a 1st year student in Jeketi University. There, you interact with friends through multi-ended choice-based storyline. This is a free fan-made project, made out of love for 48G's Virtual member for 48G's Virtual fans. Currently, this game only available in Bahasa Indonesia. We might do localization and translations in the future update. Disclaimer: This project is not affiliated in any way with JKT48 Operational Team or AKA Virtual. Any references to these entities are for contextual purposes only, and this project is independent and unaffiliated with them.
row.short_description: A fanmade visual novel game by Virtual 48Group fans for Virtual 48Group fans, which tells multiple-fanmade-stories about a group of sophisticated 48 Vtuber Idol from Jakarta, Indonesia. You play as a 1st year student where you will interact with friends through multi-ended choice-based storyline.

row.name: Doug The Digger
row.detailed_description: Doug must dig down to find resources. The resources can be sold for upgrades and used for crafting. Running out of oxygen or fuel is always a possibility.
row.short_description: Doug The Digger is a casual, single-player mining and crafting game where you aim to escape a crash landing by crafting a rocket. The gameplay is simple but addictive—play at your own risk!

row.name: ScrapDown
row.detailed_description: Scrap Down is an action-packed 2D shooter arena game, set in an exciting space theme. The game features casual and fast-paced shooting mechanics that are easy to understand to players of all ages and skill levels. The heart of Scrap Down lies in its dynamic and chaotic gameplay, where players pilot their own spaceship and dive into intense battles with friends or other players, using a variety of futuristic weapons and gadgets, keeping each match fresh and unpredictable. The arenas are filled with obstacles and interactive elements that add to the strategic depth. Whether it's setting traps, leveling up your gears or using gadgets to take down your enemies, these features ensures that no two matches are ever the same. Scrap Down offers vibrant graphics, engaging gameplay, and a perfect blend of competition and humor, Scrap Down is the go-to casual shooter game for those looking to enjoy fast-paced action and fun moments.
row.short_description: Scrap Down is action shooter arena in the style of a 2D shooter set in a space theme. It offers casual and fast-paced shooting mechanics that are easy to understand. It enhances the fun by allowing players to prank each other with in-game items.

row.name: 戦国ブシドー〜大野望の巻〜
row.detailed_description: 戦国時代を駆け抜ける大型歴史戦略SLGが登場！ ■シーズン制SLG ・本作はシーズン制を採用しており、プレイヤーは戦国時代を追体験しながら同盟のメンバーと手を組み、シーズン目標に挑戦していく。 ・占領した土地数やシーズン目標の完成数に応じてシーズンランキングが決定される。 ・新シーズンが開始するたびに土地の所属がリセットされ、新たなコンテンツも追加される。また、プレイヤーは所属勢力を再選択できるため、シーズン毎のバランス調整で均衡な対戦環境を楽しめる。 ■自由な行軍システム ・日本地図を駆け巡り、自由な行軍システムでよりスピーディに作戦を展開でき、プレイヤー同士の衝突もより多発になる。 ・攻城戦は敵対同盟の反撃を警戒しなければならない。さまざまなルートから行軍できるため、高戦力のプレイヤーによる戦力の一極集中を軽減し、より多彩な役割分担での協力プレイが可能。 ■奥深い戦略バトル ・武将・兵種・攻城兵器・武技の組み合わせによる戦略バトル！ ・9マスの戦場に最大4つの部隊を配置可能。部隊の事前編成による戦略要素が重要視される。 ・兵種には相性関係があり、武将と武技の組み合わせが戦闘結果を大きく左右する。 ・作戦の目的に合わせて、様々な兵器が使用可能。攻城戦は投石機、後方部隊への打撃は弩車、陣太鼓はPK戦、騎兵対策には木慢など、戦略性の高いバトルを楽しめる！ ■最高クラスのグラフィック ・最高クラスのグラフィックで戦国武将を魅せる！服装、鎧、武器、全てがハイクオリティ！ ・重厚感のある美しいイラストで戦国時代を描く！戦国時代へタイムスリップしたかのような圧倒的な没入感！ ■豪華声優陣による熱演(五十音順) ・桑原由気、佐倉綾音、斎藤千和、杉田智和、立花理香、速水奨、福山潤、前野智昭、佐倉綾音など、豪華声優陣が200名以上の戦国武将を熱演！
row.short_description: 天下布武への道、すなわち「武士道」なり！ 本作は戦国時代の日本を舞台に、覇を競う大型歴史戦略シミュレーションゲーム。 プレイヤーは主君となり、名だたる武将たちを従え、全国のライバルたちと天下統一を賭けた合戦が繰り広げられる。

row.name: Dreamline 404
row.detailed_description: Dear Valued Customer, Thank you for calling the Dreamline Service Center. We are committed to providing every wanderer user with the highest quality dream services. How may I help you today? 'Dreamline 404' is a short-form experimental game centered around phone calls. In the middle of the night, you're woken up by a text message from the 'Dreamline Service Center.' 'Congratulations, you're a winner!' Probably just a scam, you think. But the message's glitchy text and overall strangeness spark your curiosity. Your phone, a mysterious message, and a weird number you can't resist calling. Are you ready to dial into the unknown? Immerse yourself in a diverse collection of dreams from Wanderer users. Let our original soundtrack wash over you as you find your inner peace within vibrant dreamscapes. Please remember that Dreamline Corporation is your one and only trusted friend on this dream journey. At Dreamline, we're all about following your dreams. So let's make your life one where... ...Where all your dreams are not just your dreams. :) Controls Contact us · Game Design / Art / Narrative By @Blu  Daydreaminblu_studio@outlook.com · Programming By @VoidCatt   voidcattdev@gmail.com · Music By @Yellow   yunhaohwang@gmail.com Special Thanks English Localization by Max Ponoroff
row.short_description: Thank you for calling the Dreamline Service Center. We are dedicated to providing you with the highest quality dream services. How may I assist you today?

row.detailed_description: Step into the mesmerizing realm of 'ARCANE RUSH: Auto Battler' an enthralling card game that immerses you in a captivating adventure featuring mystical heroes and epic battles. Construct your deck, summon formidable allies, and partake in strategic clashes against adversaries hailing from every corner of the realm! Key Features: Unleash Your Tactical Mastery: Engage in intense card-based battles, strategically deploying your deck and unleashing devastating abilities. Craft cunning tactics, make calculated decisions, and claim victory against fierce opponents! Legendary Heroes: Choose from a roster of legendary heroes, each with their own unique abilities and playstyles. Unlock new heroes as you progress, uncover their gripping backstories, and master their signature moves. Deck Building Mastery: Collect a vast array of cards, from mythical creatures and mighty spells to enchanted artifacts. Construct your decks with precision, combining synergistic cards that harmonize with your hero's strengths. Thrilling battles: Engage in exhilarating battles against formidable opponents. Rise through the ranks, earn renown, and become the ultimate Arena champion! Strategic Depth: Develop your tactical prowess as you carefully manage resources, plan your moves, and counter your opponent's strategies. Adapt to changing circumstances, seize opportunities, and turn the tide of battle in your favor. Expansive Content: Embark on a journey filled with endless possibilities. Experience regular updates and expansions, introducing new cards, heroes, and exciting game modes to keep your adventures fresh and ever-engaging. Are you ready to join the battles and prove your mettle? Gather your cards, hone your skills, and prepare for an unforgettable card battle experience like no other!
row.short_description: ARCANE RUSH: Epic Card Battles. Clash, strategize, dominate!
