row.name: Infernal Bloodrush
row.detailed_description: Infernal Bloodrush is a 2.5d first-person doomlike where instead of shooting bullets, you burn through a horde of demons with fire magic. A few days ago, you were dragged from the darkness of the dungeon and made an offer. You would be released, on the condition that you lend the Realm your strength for a short period. Your charge: to stem the flow of demons and protect the Realm. Destroy enemies by unleashing your Fire magic, by utilising an arsenal of powerful abilities. Spread fire by liting dead enemies' blood on fire. Explore sunken map while you defend a gate to the overworld.
row.short_description: As demons threaten to spill into the world, it's up to you to protect the Realm by burning every demon to ash.

row.name: Chrono Club - Race Against Time
row.detailed_description: Throughout history racing tournaments have had the goal of determining the best racer alive. However, the Chrono Club initiative has aimed to go even higher! They intend to find the best kart racer of all time, front and back! It is going to be a race against time. Be the fastest in circuits full of danger! Beat your friends in local mode Chose among different racers and environments This game was developed as a 4th-year student project at DigiPen Europe-Bilbao for educational purposes. Please check out our publisher page for more information.
row.short_description: The biggest karting tournament throughout history is being held, dragging in racers from all over the timeline in order to determine one thing and one thing only: Who is the best racer of all time?

row.name: Pineapple Panic!
row.detailed_description: Are you a fan of sarcasm, the 90s, and pineapples? Then Pineapple Panic! is the game for you! In Pineapple Panic! , you play as Piña, a sarcastic pineapple on the run from the temperamental chef, Joe Colada, who is determined to turn you into a delicious beverage. In this endless runner the main goal is simple, survive as long as you can without getting caught by Joe Colada. He'll say anything to get you to slow down, so stay sharp! Maintain your distance from Joe by jumping over and dodging obstacles. Collect pineapple chunks to earn a unique ability that you can use to slow Joe down. Challenge yourself with the Leaderboard system, which allows you to see the top scores. Meet Piña: Life as a pineapple isn't easy, according to Piña. Between beach lounging and long naps, Piña never imagined he'd be sprinting for his life. Everything changed when Joe Colada started chasing him, turning his peaceful life into an endless escape. Meet Joe Colada: With a flair for dramatic presentations and a relentless pursuit of culinary perfection, Joe Colada is always looking for the finest ingredients. And he believes Piña is the pièce de resistance he needs. Why will you love Pineapple Panic? Humor and Sarcasm: Piña's witty commentary and the game's humorous take on the endless runner genre will keep you entertained. Retro Aesthetic: Relive the 90s with vibrant visuals and a catchy, nostalgic soundtrack. Challenging Yet Fun: The game is easy to pick up but hard to master, providing endless fun and replayability. Note: No pineapples were harmed in the making of this game.
row.short_description: Have your games become bland and fruitless? Help Pina, the terrified pineapple, to dodge and leap over obstacles so that he can outwit the dastardly Chef Joe Colada in this rear-facing endless runner. Can you outpace his culinary madness, or will you end up in a fruity predicament?

row.name: Slap That
row.detailed_description: Experience the only first-person 'Slapper' game where you take control of an enraged being navigating through a skyscraper by slapping everything and everyone in sight. Run, jump, and clear your path to the next level by slapping anything in your way. Discover secret snails in each level and slap them too. Confront multiple enemies and slap them into submission. You can even use any object as a weapon by slapping it! In this game, everything is designed for you to slap. Play 'Slap That!' and unleash your slapping fury! Slap obstacles! Slap enemies! Find your way to the next level by... slapping! This game was developed as a 4th-year student project at DigiPen Europe-Bilbao for educational purposes. Please check out our publisher page for more information.
row.short_description: Slap almost anything blocking your way in order to go deeper and deeper and discover what is going on in this world!

row.name: Age of Defense: Prehistory
row.detailed_description: Tribe big trouble. Еnemies want kill tribe. Player call defenders. Defenders kill enemies. Enemies bring meat. Meat bring new defenders. Good player kill all enemies! Hold enemy. Easier to kill. Stones and sticks - friends. Be caveman. See it? Kill it. Eat it! Repeat this million times.
row.short_description: The most addicting tower defense game, packed with monsters and tough defenders, all of which fit perfectly into the cartoonish environment. Prehistory is a prologue for the main story Age of Defense.

row.name: Chibi Reboot
row.detailed_description: Du magst den alten PacMan Klassiker? Du magst Roboter? Dann ist 'Chibi Reboot' genau das richtige Spiel für dich! 'Chibi Reboot', ist ein Pac-Man ähnliches Spiel wobei ihr einen kleinen verschollenen Roboter helfen müsst nach Hause zu kommen. Dabei müsst ihr Chibi helfen Energiekristalle zu sammeln und gefährlichen Monstern aus dem Weg zu gehen. Begleite den kleinen Roboter auf seiner Reise und sammle mit ihm hilfreiche Items um seinen Gegnern einen Schritt voraus zu sein. Führe Chibi durch insgesamt 16 verschiedene Level mit steigendem Schwierigkeitsgrad. Sammle verschiedene Items und stelle dich deinen Gegnern. Achte auf deine Herzanzeige, und lasse Chibi nicht auf dem Schrottplatz enden. 8-bit Hintergrundmusik
row.short_description: Führe Chibi durch insgesamt 16 verschiedene Level mit steigendem Schwierigkeitsgrad. Sammle verschiedene Items und stelle dich deinen Gegnern. Achte auf deine Herzanzeige, und lasse Chibi nicht auf dem Schrottplatz enden. 8-bit Hintergrundmusik

row.name: Cassiculus
row.detailed_description: This terrifying first-person horror experience immerses the player into a world of isolation, fear, paranoia and claustrophobia as you make your way through the Oberon Cave. Throughout the game, you will experience atmospheric environments, disturbing audio and horrifying visuals. Delve deep into the Oberon Cave In a remote cave deep in the wilderness a team of amateur spelunkers set out to explore its mysterious depths. It's not long until their excitement turns into terror as they delve deeper into the darkness, they soon stumble upon a terrifying discovery. Gameplay Equipped with a trusty headtorch, you must explore the regions of the cave in search of your brother and his friends. Cassiculus features no combat. This experience focuses primarily on atmosphere and dread. There are multiple cutscenes to encounter, items to discover and other secrets along the way.
row.short_description: This terrifying first-person horror experience immerses the player into a world of isolation, fear, paranoia and claustrophobia as you make your way through the Oberon Cave. Throughout the game, you will experience atmospheric environments, disturbing audio and horrifying visuals.

row.name: Stinkytown
row.detailed_description: You are the Mayor of Stinkytown. Your town stinks after a bit of a downward spiral you've experienced lately. It is time to clean up your land because even the greatest mayor can't live in stink indefinitely. Solve puzzles, manage energy and clean your surroundings in Stinkytown, a small puzzle game. SOLVE PUZZLES Find puzzles around the house, and use various methods to solve them. INTERACT WITH OBJECTS Some objects have lore, discover them all while doing your mayorly duties. CLEAN AREAS Bring colour back to your house, and take out the trash. It's good for your mental health! TAKE A NAP Even the bravest mayor needs a nap sometimes. Recover energy to continue your journey. Coming Soon!
row.short_description: You are the Mayor of Stinkytown. Your town stinks after a bit of a downward spiral you've experienced lately. Solve puzzles, manage energy and clean your surroundings in Stinkytown, a small puzzle game. Coming soon!

row.name: Kharakov
row.detailed_description: Explore forgotten land, climb on structures, view the scenery and interact with NPCs and environment to discover secrets and more fun facts from most recent campaign from BaniakBaniaka. Play this single person mode game walking simulator and spend time exploring the environment to find interactive items that provide more context on world or characters. Use free view to take screenshots of locations. Follow simple quests, ride a mule. This game is in early stages of production, more content will follow with future updates. Step into the epic world of 'Kharakow,' a fan-made game brought to life by the passionate creators of the Albion Forge. Inspired by the gripping RPG campaign 'Wydaleni' hosted on the popular polish YouTube channel Baniak Baniaka, this game is a tribute to the dwarven residents of Kharakow.
row.short_description: Explore forgotten land, climb on structures, view the scenery and interact with NPCs and environment to discover secrets and more lore from most recent campaign from BaniakBaniaka.
row.notes: This Game may contain content not appropriate for all ages. It may contain General Mature Content, Crime, Brutality, and may include Nudity or Sexual Content.

row.name: D.N.A: Do Not Answer
row.detailed_description: D.N.A: Do Not Answer About this Game: D.N.A is our debut PC game, a story-driven (or interactive drama) horror experience. Mainly developed by a small team of three passionate creators at Well of Tales, this short and intense game is offered for free as an introduction to our walk in the game industry. Plot Summary: You play as Alice, a young nurse who wakes up in an apparently abandoned hospital. As you navigate this eerie setting, you find your phone, charged to just 7%, which becomes your only source of light in the increasingly dark and twisted corridors. As Alice explores the hospital, she uncovers clues to piece together her fragmented memories while striving to escape. Beware, the longer you stay in the dark, the greater the chance the lurking presence will catch you. Gameplay: D.N.A is a first-person horror game where each decision can lead to a different ending. As Alice, your mission is to escape the hospital, recover your memories, and avoid succumbing to the darkness. The game alternates between intense gameplay and cinematic scenes, ensuring a deeply engaging experience. Game Features: Immersive Storytelling: A gripping narrative that pulls you into Alice's mysterious and terrifying predicament. Atmospheric Exploration: Traverse a hospital that transforms from seemingly clean and abandoned to a decaying, metaphysical nightmare. Strategic Gameplay: Conserve your phone’s battery by finding charging stations to survive the encroaching darkness. Multiple Endings: Your choices shape Alice's fate, leading to different outcomes based on your gameplay. High-Quality Production: Enjoy a photorealistic and immersive environment created with Unity 3D, featuring professional voice acting by Elisabeth Yorke Bolognini and original soundtrack. Will you help Alice find the way out, or will the darkness claim her?
row.short_description: 'D.N.A is a short first-person, story-driven horror game developed by a small idipendent studio. Players navigate an eerie, abandoned hospital, uncover clues, manage limited light sources, and face a dark presence. Featuring multiple endings, realistic graphics, and immersive sound design.'

row.name: 100 Hiddensaurs
row.detailed_description: Dinosaurs escaped from a secret laboratory and used a time machine to travel to different eras. Help the crazy professor find them all. When you find them, try hardmode with a timer and no help. The prizes will be mini games.
row.short_description: 100 Hiddensaurs is a hidden object game with dinosaurs. The game is drawn by hand.

row.name: Diplomacy is Not an Option: Shareware
row.detailed_description: The prequel invites you to participate in the events preceding the story told in the campaign of the main game. You are the famous filibuster Duncan Ironbrow, who was unexpectedly dragged into 'big politics'. You are destined to become a hero of the Battle for Independence of Samreignia. Two story missions, plus one Endless Mode exclusive map layout await you. Like in the original RTS-game, in Diplomacy is Not an Option: Shareware, you need to develop your economy and hire armies, to stand against overwhelming enemy forces. Build fortifications, raise your armies, and experience warfare on an entirely new scale. Over 25 THOUSAND enemies will assault your castle walls. Every arrow, catapult stone and enemy launched skywards is physically modeled, making for a tactile and coherent battlefield. Just make sure your troops have towers to shoot from and clear lines of sight, or you might find your best-laid plans embarrassingly blunted by your own fortifications. Create kill-zones and fall-back positions. You will need to take an active role in combat to get the best from your men. A functional army requires a functional economy to support and feed it. Food, Wood, Stone, Iron, and Gold are the foundations of your city’s economy, and you will need to watch your supplies carefully if you are to meet the advancing foe in a timely manner. Gather resources, choose your storage locations, plan your expansions and upgrades with care. The enemy will not cede their lands willingly, and unprotected civilian expansions will have consequences of falling prey to the hostile incursion. Trade, via the impressive merchant dirigible, bringing emergency supplies of food to feed the men, or stone to rebuild the walls. Of course, sturdy castle walls will protect you from most ordinary threats, but why use only might whereas magic exists as well? Learn it yourself and trap the souls of your fallen enemies. There are few spells in the game, but using any of them can change the course of the battle. Build magical monuments, harvest soul crystals and give a try to a maniacal laugh as searing magical beams tear through your foes and summoned Dark Knights to chase down the stragglers. Oh, and don't forget about the ability to freeze time. After all, pausing the game is a kind of 'magic' that is available to you at any moment.
row.short_description: Diplomacy is Not an Option: Shareware is a free prequel to the original game. In a medieval fantasy world, you are to build settlements, raise huge armies, and defend against massive hordes of enemies. Learn how Ironbrow clan shaped the world's map the first time - if you survive, that is.

row.name: Farm Debt Repay Life:Prologue
row.detailed_description: Add Wishlist About the Game Game description : 'Farm Debt Repay Life: Prelogue' is the prologue version of 'Farm Debt Repay Life' ,allowing players to experience the first 15 days of gameplay, including the storyline. It features the same fully randomized resource generation and diverse random buffs as the full version. Players can enjoy cultivating farmland, planting crops, mining minerals, smelting ores, upgrading, and crafting various tools. Game Features : Rich resources, free to explore. You can freely explore here, collecting abundant resources and various minerals in the wild (refreshed once a week) to develop and operate the farm. farming, to increase wealth. You can grow more than 20+ species of crops on your farm, fish more than 30+ species of fish on the river or sea, and further process these outputs for higher value returns. Reasonable expansion and control of finances. Although you are carrying a large amount of debt, and the interest will continue to increase (as in reality :)), you can borrow to expand properly, use the borrowed funds to grow rapidly, quickly accumulate wealth, reduce your debt, avoid heavy interest, and eventually become a financial management master. Extract Buff, improve ability. You can spend a certain amount of money to obtain over 90+ buffs that will increase your ability to pay off debt to an incredible degree, such as reducing the growing time of crops, doubling the value of processed items, getting more fish when fishing, etc...... Start your own farm and pay off your debts!
row.short_description: this is the prologue version of 'Farm Debt Repay Life', challenge you with randomized resources and buffs. Cultivate farmland, mine minerals, craft tools, and repay a huge debt with wisdom and hard work. Along the way, uncover the secrets of three enigmatic cat girls and forge friendships with them.

row.name: VPN Simulator
row.detailed_description: VPN Simulator is at the pinnacle of today's technology, giving you the ability to pretend to be able to avoid law enforcement when searching how to bake cakes. Connect to another country, or even another VPN service! Features: Epic Music! Mouse Movement!!! Numbers and Words!!!! No Cops!!!!! Buttons!!!!!!
row.short_description: VPN Simulator is a clicker simulator for VPNs. Connect and disconnect through various places and times.

row.name: PandaBomber
row.detailed_description: Step into the explosive world of PandaBomber, a modern reimagining of the classic Bomberman experience! Engage in fast-paced, strategic gameplay that challenges you to think on your feet while delivering heart-pounding action. Whether you're outwitting opponents with crafty bomb placements or dodging explosions in high-stakes battles, every moment in PandaBomber is filled with excitement. Competitive Multiplayer Go head-to-head with friends or foes in thrilling, fast-paced matches. Dynamic Arenas Explore a variety of unique, destructible arenas that keep the gameplay fresh and engaging. Skill-based Strategy Plant bombs, trap enemies, and use your environment to your advantage to claim victory. High-energy Combat With quick rounds and increasing intensity, every match pushes you to refine your skills and react faster than ever before. Are you ready to blast your way to victory? Join the chaos, perfect your strategy, and dominate the leaderboards in PandaBomber!
row.short_description: PandaBomber is a fast-paced, competitive Bomberman-inspired game where strategy meets adrenaline. Outwit your opponents, plant bombs, and claim victory in intense multiplayer battles. Master your moves, explode your enemies, and reign supreme in the ultimate explosive showdown!

In this state, he becomes trapped in his imaginary world fed by the screen before his eyes. To free himself, he needs to explore this world and defeat the entity that's actively triggering his dream. row.short_description: It's free, try it ;) Third person souls-like featuring a solid combat mechanic, 5 explorable levels, 3 big boss fights, mobs, cutscenes, unlockables, and a main story.

row.name: Pixel Flip
row.detailed_description: Pixel Flip is an engaging puzzle game that challenges players to match and collect cards across endless stages of Pixel Flipping amusement. Immerse yourself in a vibrant pixelated world where every flip could bring you closer to completing your collection. Featuring a charming pixel art style that brings nostalgic vibes to the forefront, dive into a colorful world filled with adorable characters and vibrant environments. Each card flip is accompanied by satisfying sound effects and beautiful background music, enhancing the overall gameplay experience. Embark on a journey through the endless stages, each presenting a new set of challenges and surprises. Match identical cards to uncover their hidden pixels and add them to your collection. Strategize your moves wisely to rank up your character faster! Can you flip your way to victory and become the ultimate Pixel Collector?
row.short_description: Embark on endless stages of card matching fun. Dive into a vibrant world, collect all the 'Pixels', strategize your moves and level up your character. Can you become the ultimate Pixel Collector?

row.name: Gears Of Time
row.detailed_description: Game created In Creanavarra. Dungeon Crawler with Platforming, Action, and Bullet Hell elements with a Gear-Like Hability System. The player must escape from a large tower after having stolen the hourglass. You must go down the different floors that make up the tower, avoiding its traps, fighting with its guardians and solving the necessary puzzles to escape alive. The character will acquire new objects and skills that will help him in all these situations and which he can combine to obtain powerful synergies. You will manage your life, your dash and the power to slow down time with gears. This game is a university project so it is not completely polished, we still want to hear your opinion of the game, whether good or bad.
row.short_description: It is an Isometric Dungeon Crawler with a few RPG elements in which the character must escape from a great tower after stealing the hourglass.

row.name: Wicked Arcana
row.detailed_description: Please Note: Announced on September 6th, 'Wicked Arcana' will temporarily not be updated or worked on at this time. We've decided to take a break to start something new! We plan to revisit 'Wicked Arcana' in the future, so make sure to follow us to stay up-to-date. ~Novus Studio Step into the mystical world of Wicked Arcana, where ancient runes unlock powerful magic and hidden truths. In this stylized action RPG, blend the art of melee combat with the mystique of rune-based spells to unravel a story inspired by mythological lore. Embrace the challenge of mastering diverse combat techniques, explore enchanting environments brimming with secrets, and embark on a quest that transcends the boundaries of traditional mythology. With every rune collected, uncover a narrative woven with the threads of legends, reimagined in a world where magic is not just a tool, but a gateway to discovering your true potential. Wicked Arcana is not just a game—it's a journey into a realm where your actions shape the legacy of myths. Integrative Rune-based Magic System Central to 'Wicked Arcana' is its innovative rune magic system, where runes are not only used for combat but also serve as keys for exploration and puzzle-solving. This system interweaves gameplay with lore, enriching both combat and environmental interaction. Deep and Engaging Combat The game melds melee combat with strategic magic use, providing a dynamic combat experience. It rewards skill and strategic planning, requiring players to balance physical attacks and magical abilities. Rich Narrative 'Wicked Arcana' presents a unique story that’s universal yet distinctive in its storytelling. This narrative depth encourages exploration and discovery, immersing players in a world where their actions resonate with mythological grandeur.
row.short_description: Step into the mystical world of 'Wicked Arcana,' where ancient runes unlock powerful magic and hidden truths in this early access demo.

CHARACTER SELECTION Choose 1 from 9 available characters. From the remaining, 3 opponents will be randomly chosen to fight you in battle. CHARACTER ABILITIES Every character has 3 abilities, 'skill', 'buff' and 'punch'. An ability will be chosen at random each turn. FLOW OF COMBAT Combat plays out in 3 phases: The 'Target Phase', 'Choice Phase', and 'Battle Phase'. - Target Phase: The 4 participants will automatically determine their target(s) for the turn, influenced by their abilities. - Choice Phase: By using 'mana', the player can choose cards to change the conditions of battle. row.name: KiLLPaKu!
row.detailed_description: ーーーーーーーーーーーーーーーーーーーーーーーーーーーーーーーーーーーーーー This work is a game created at Byking Co., Ltd.'s training for new employees. A 3D action game where you control Bebe, a gluttonous monster. Aim at the weak points of the fighting 'onis' and deal the final blow! Literally, enjoy picking the best parts! ■Three types of “copying”, “predation”, “stealing”, and “imitation” Make full use of the 3 actions to earn more scores within the 3 minute time limit! Eat as much as you can to avoid being defeated and aim for S rank! ■The first “rip-off” and “predation” It can extend its tongue to eat weakened prey. There are two ways to eat, one is to eat quickly in a straight line, and the other is to eat in batches while rotating. ■Second “rip-off” and “stealing” It is the act of finding a weakened enemy and taking the final blow from the prey. They have low intelligence and are easily angered, and ``Red Oni'' and ``Blue Oni'' often fight each other just because of their color difference.

row.name: First Person Stapler
row.detailed_description: Update Notes Additions: -New Level: Renovation I knew early on that I wanted to include a construction stapler as a weapon option. So, I felt like I needed to include a construction area in the game. The new level of the game let's you explore a half-built floor of the office building, hunting targets around exposed beams, piles of bricks, and gapped scaffolding. -Collectibles: Flair This game is very, very heavily inspired by Office Space and old stories from ANMA. I needed to do something with flair because that scene is too good to leave out, but too out of context to build into any gameplay. So, there are now 13(?) pieces of flair scattered throughout the game. If you see something, shoot something. -Mini Games: Shooting Gallery I revamped the Warehouse for another mini-game, this time a shooting range. There are barriers set up with boxes, targets that flip up and down, all the good stuff. Test your speed and accuracy at the shooting range. Fixes: -Doors are now more responsive, you can read about their history here. -Music is a hell of a lot lower. I watched some people stream my game and realized not everyone wants an office-based rave. Thanks for playing. About the Game Kill time at your call center night shift by shooting targets with a stapler, kicking doors, breaking photocopiers, popping balloons, guzzling coffee, stealing moon shoes, kicking your coworker's computers off a desk, and generally wrecking up the place. The game is simple, get to the exit and shoot as many targets as possible on your way. Shooting clocks will give you more time, coffee speeds you up, headshots give a higher score, and, different kinds of staplers can be found around the map. Clear levels with a high score to unlock the next level and a few ridiculous mini-games

row.name: Containment Breach
row.detailed_description: Aim For The Head The only way to kill zombies is by shooting them in the head. However, each of their arms can absorb bullets unless you shoot them.. or explode them off. Shooting limbs wastes ammo but rewards you with more points. Upgrade Each run starts the same, just you and your pistol. Kill enemies to get points to buy up to five different perks and ten different weapons. Each weapon can be upgraded up to two times to obtain elemental modifiers. Escape Or Survive Follow the objectives to make your way out of the facility as fast as possible, but you will have to override the vault door, and that can attract a lot of attention... Or you can choose to stay and survive as many rounds as possible. Feedback Appreciated This is my first game I have put out there so feel free to leave any feedback and I will work on updating the game to address any balance issues, game breaking bugs, and unclear mechanics. I have already gathered a list of player feedback to implement soon. About The Developer Hello. I am a solo developer making games after my 9-5 job. This is my first game I have actually managed to released and I did most of the art myself (I am mostly a programmer). I plan to push updates to address player feedback as it comes in, and i really appreciate it. In the meantime ill be working on an expanded idea of this game that will include a base-building and tower defense mechanic, as well as multiplayer.

row.name: Utility for the Soul
row.detailed_description: A proposal for enlightened corporations with a concern for the social implications resulting from prolonged neglect of human needs in our mechanized society. - Lithuanian-American environment artist Aleksandra Kasuba, 1970 A corporation is to build and maintain a Retreat House to provide its people with relief from everyday demands and pressures of the office. The Retreat house is to be used by all corporation employees on a rotational basis, on the corporation’s time and at its expense. The visitor will spend most of his time in the Galleries, where the elemental displays take place. The Galleries are designed to feel enormous, seemingly without walls, and to sound like echo chambers. Here the visitor will encounter the Elements: Earth, Air, Fire, Water. Given time unregimented, confronted with Elemental occurances, and free from a constant rush of information which stifles natural reactions, the visitor would be able to experience the self in an environment not by the dictates of a particular society, but be forced to respond to himself alone. The experience could reveal one’s true self, and hopefully stir it enough to pursue its substance. Aleksandra Kasuba (1923 – 2019) - a Lithuanian-American environment artist. In 1970 she authored Utility for the Soul , a competition entry in a short book format for Projects Outside Art launched by Experiments in Art and Technology (E.A.T.) , an organization developing collaborations between artists and engineers. Utility for the Soul would eventually become Kasuba’s manifesto, implementing the utopian goal at the core of her research, the search for a harmonious world and a peaceful dialogue between humankind, nature and technology. FEATURES Original utopian narrative - based upon a short story by artist Aleksandra Kasuba Puzzle infused gameplay - 11 rooms to explore, each with a unique elemental puzzle Ambient soundscape - meditative, soothing atmosphere Minimalist graphics - hand animated black and white visuals Multiple languages - Playable in English, French and Lithuanian Miniature experience - 15 to 30 min. of gameplay REVIEWS A space in which we can ponder the dual nature of what it means to encounter a critique of a data-driven busy society on a device which facilitates exactly what the art piece sets out to critique in the first place. - IndieCade 2021 Jury ABOUT THE DEVELOPER Weekend Warriors is a small and young independent games collective from Vilnius, Lithuania. Game design - Povilas Vincentas Jankūnas Programming - Daumantas Šimkus, Mykolas Krupauskas, Aleksandras Trakas Sounds & Music - Ignas Čeponis
row.short_description: A miniature meditative puzzle experience based on the Lithuanian-American environment artist Aleksandra Kasuba’s concept of the Retreat House - a unique, utopian facility used by large corporations to rejuvenate their overworked employees.

row.name: Mr. Rightaway

row.name: Raspberry

row.short_description: Discover 2 brand new SmartGames for Tilt Five™! Outsmart your opponent and race across the finish line first in Rat Raze or work together to reach the treasure in Road to Riches

row.name: The Tunnels
row.detailed_description: The Tunnels is a procedural maze environment, where everyone loses except grief This work reflects on the human cost of conflict. The information presented is based on real-time data, aiming to show how statistics can obscure the profound grief behind the numbers, and how we always see information through different lenses. This experience is not intended to entertain, but to provide a space for reflection on the human consequences of conflict, with profound respect for all victims and their families. There is, however, an end to reach in this hallway. In this immersive installation, the viewer evolves through a real and defining political space that most people have only seen through news, screens, and social media. A real non-space that can only be the projection of the viewer, and the developer, is constructed to try to make sense of the inhumane. After the overwhelming labyrinth of contradicting informations we are all constantly subjected to, what can only be the truth is a mirror showing us what remains of our humanity. The work is free but you can help the work of the UNWRA on their website.
row.short_description: The Tunnels is a procedural maze environment, where everyone loses except grief What can only be the final truth is a mirror showing us what remains of our humanity. There is, however, an end to reach in this hallway.

row.name: Itty Bitty Toilet Kitty
row.detailed_description: BE A CAT and SAVE YOUR HUMAN from the GREEBLES! In Itty Bitty Toilet Kitty , you play as a cute feline on a mission to protect your beloved human from flesh-eating toilet monsters — the dreaded GREEBLES ! What to expect: A microgame — around 15 minutes of total playtime A very silly story Simple but fun gameplay A retro-style soundtrack My first solo dev project CAT! Note from the developer: I made this game after losing my job as a games writer. Originally, it was a paid game (99p) — after being unemployed for a year and a half, I couldn’t justify not charging something. Now that I’m back working as a games writer again, I’ve decided to make it free forever . It’s a very silly little game, but it brought me a lot of joy during a dark time, and I hope it brings a smile (and maybe a laugh) to anyone who gives it a try.
row.short_description: BE A CAT! SAVE YOUR HUMAN! You're a fluffy feline who must save their owner from the hordes of flesh eating greebles which dwell within the bathroom. Will she make it through her morning business alive? Only you can save her!

row.name: Pug and Seek
row.detailed_description: Welcome to Pug and Seek: an exciting hide-and-seek game where the action never ends! Choose your side in this thrilling challenge: will you be the formidable MrJackx or one of the cunning pugs? Game Modes: MrJackx: Play as MrJackx, a tireless streamer who will stop at nothing to catch all the mischievous pugs. Use your wits and skills to explore the maze-like map, find the most unlikely hiding spots, and surprise the pugs. Only the fastest and most strategic will manage to catch them all! Pugs: In this mode, you are a pug trying to escape the relentless wrath of MrJackx. Run, hide, and use every corner of the map to avoid being caught. Your speed and adaptability will be your best weapons to survive until time runs out. Key Features: Online Multiplayer Game: Challenge your friends or MrJackx himself in multiplayer matches. Who will be the best at hiding or catching? Special Abilities: Use special abilities that will give you the decisive advantage, whether you are seeking or escaping. Choose your side, hone your skills, and dive into the adventure of Pug and Seek! Join the challenge and prove who the real master of hide-and-seek is!
row.short_description: Pug and Seek is a hide-and-seek game: clever pugs run, hide, and cause chaos, while Jack, the unstoppable streamer, must find, catch, and return them to the pen. Challenge friends online and prove who is the master of hide-and-seek!

row.name: Haven & Hearth
row.detailed_description: Haven & Hearth is a MMORPG (Massive Multiplayer Online Roleplaying Game) set in a fictional world loosely inspired by Slavic and Germanic myth and legend. The game sets itself apart from other games in the genre in its aim to provide players with an interactive, affectable and mutable game world, which can be permanently and fundamentally changed and affected through actions undertaken by the players. Our fundamental goal with Haven & Hearth is to create a game in which player choices have permanent and/or lasting effects and, thus, providing said players with a meaningful and fun gaming experience. Skills & Attributes Develop your character to unlock new Skills , Abilities , and Credos . Devour sumptuous feasts of food and drink to increase your Strength , Intelligence , Agility and other base Attributes . Study sundry Curiosities of nature and artifice to gain Learning Points to increase your Farming , Masonry , Exploration and other Abilities . Experience oddities and obscure situations to gain experience points and cast or incant the spells and charms of Hearth Magic . Discover materials previously unknown to you to unlock new recipes for Crafting & Building . Hunting & Gathering Slay vicious beasts of nature, flay their hides and tan for leather. Make sausages of Boar, and smoke Sea Gull Meat. Feasting and a varied diet is important to all Hearthlings . Forage rare flowers to Study , or bind them into bouquets for additional Learning Points . Traverse the vast- and wilderness of Haven & Hearth's procedurally generated world and gather rare Herbs, Mushrooms and Flowes. Pick wild seeds to grow into domestic crops for Farming , such as Grapes, Wheat, Carrots or Peas. Tame wild animals to raise Livestock like Cows, Pigs, Goats or Reindeer. Ride like the wind upon mighty Horses wild and tame, and breed your animals to ever rising qualities. Fish or cast nets in Rivers, Lakes, Oceans or Caves to catch a wide variety of aquatic life such as Cod, Perch, Bream, Halibut, Clams, Crabs, or Lobsters. Should true bravery inspire you; Venture into the depths of the cavernous underworlds of Dungeons such as Beaver Lodges, Bat Caves, or Ant Hills. Thraximundar's Vicious Hive of Tyranny awaits! Dig deep and greedily down multiple levels of caves, to extract minerals, ores, and precious gems from the inky fathoms below the plane of the Hearth. Mining and Forging are essential for progress, but rumors speak of Trolls in the deep! Crafting & Building Terraform the Hearth by digging, paving, plowing or planting. Hearthlings are the wolves of Hearthlings: Stake a Claim to your corner of the Hearth to protect it from roving bands of others. Construct mighty walls and palisades to keep your homestead safe. Erect homes and Houses of log and stone, from humble cabins to mighty towers. Smelt ores for metal, and refine further metallurgical advances in Finery Forges and Steel Crucibles . Cook as varied a diet as you can by building Ovens for Bread, Cauldrons for Stews, Sheds for Smoking or Meat Grinders for Sausages. Decorate with a wide variety of wall mountings, lanterns, shelves, tables, cupboards, and many other pieces of furniture. Construct Boats & Ships to carry you across the oceans blue, from humble Coracles to mighty Knarrs. Upload Custom Graphics to give that extra flair to banners, shields, flags, capes, and sails! Cycle and recycle your production line, acquire better materials and refine your production chains to increase the Quality of all produce. Things are what you make them; Watch the color and tenor of the Variable Materials you use reflected in the things you build and make. Should the Rocking Chair be made from Cherry, Maple, or Oak? Permanent Death & Open PvP Master the Dark Arts of Trespassing , Theft , Rage , Vandalism and Murder to impose upon others who roam the Hearth. Increase your Perception & Exploration to track down and bring to justice all breakers of peace and oaths, by tracking the vicious Stenches of Crime . Construct mighty Siege Machines and engines of war to bring the flames of war to foreign lands. Found Villages to claim large swathes of land and organize kith and kin into mighty bands. Found Realms and lay claim to entire Provinces by capturing the ancient Thingwalls dotting the Hearth. Bury the dead and fulfill the will of the ancestors to draw upon the strength of your previous lives. Experience the thrill of a world where all interactions with your fellow Hearthling carries the potentiality for grave consequence.
row.short_description: A free-to-play MMORPG with crafting, building, landscaping, foraging, hunting, fishing, a dash of poetry, and open PvP combat,
row.notes: Haven & Hearth holds itself to a generally high level of decorum, and does not strive to shock or titillate its audience, however; - Player characters in the game can be dressed down to their birthday suits. - Some drugs are depicted in game. - Natural animal reproduction is, comically, represented. - Player characters can die. Haven & Hearth also, however, being fundamentally an online game played with other people, and allowing for conflict between players and their factions, has the following characteristics; - Interactions with other people in game are not pre-moderated. Mean words can be spoken, and evil deeds undertaken. - Player-versus-Player combat is free, mostly open, and cannot be opted-out of. - Free building and landscaping by players allows for artistic expressions in many of its potential forms. Beauty, truly, lies in the eye of the beholder.

row.name: Bloodcrave: R18 Prologue
row.detailed_description: Welcome to the dark and alluring world of Bloodcrave, a thrilling vampire-themed visual novel that will take you on a journey of love, corruption, and tough choices. Follow the story of Alex, a young engineer who finds himself in the middle of a battle between vampires and vigilantes. When he is saved by Chloe, a fierce vampire hunter, he discovers that his blood holds a secret that could change the balance of power forever. Will he use his newfound strength to help Chloe rid the city of ruthless vampires, or will he succumb to his dark desires and become a force of destruction? As you delve deeper into the game, you'll encounter six captivating love interests , each with their own unique storylines, personalities, and intimate moments. But be careful, as jealousy can have severe consequences in this world of danger and temptation. The decisions you make will have a drastic impact on the outcome of the game, with multiple endings and epilogues for each character. Will you lead your companions down the path of virtue, or will you make them succumb to the lure of darkness? As you plan your actions for each day, you'll discover hidden quests, events, and animated scenes that bring this captivating world to life. Immerse yourself in the interactive storytelling, as you decide whether to become a skilled vampire hunter, pursue your love interests, or indulge in something more nefarious. Features: Play the first 3 hours of Bloodcrave! You can import saves to the full game! Explore romantic relationships with six captivating love interests, each with their own unique branching storylines. Enjoy fully animated voice-acted scenes to immerse yourself in the game's world. Plan your days carefully by choosing which locations to visit and who to meet, shaping the direction of the story. Visit over two dozen unique locations, each holding its own secrets and dangers. Follow the main story with five different endings and discover multiple epilogues for each character, offering satisfying conclusions to their individual story arcs.
row.short_description: In Bloodcrave, immerse yourself in a thrilling vampire-themed visual novel with six love interests, animated scenes, and decision-driven storytelling. Will you lead your companions down the path of virtue or succumb to the lure of darkness? The choice is yours.
row.notes: Blood and violence, Horror, Explicit language, Adult-Only Sexual Content

row.name: Puddle

Each level features unique and challenging gimmicks as you attempt make your way to the top. Puddle is accompanied by an album of serene piano pieces, but it may not be so leisurely a time to complete each level. Luckily, there happens to be some strange birds to assist you on your way. Use their help to make it to the top and help the little girl make a splash.
row.short_description: Puddle is a short vertical platformer where you do lots of jumping in different themed levels with various gimmicks. Accompanied by an album of piano pieces, make your way to the top of each level with some help from peculiar birds who will encourage you along the way.

row.name: Split Fiction - Friend's Pass
row.detailed_description: Download Friend's Pass* to play Split Fiction with a friend for free on any platform! Try the early stages of the game in couch co-op or online cross-platform with another owner of the Friend's Pass. If a friend owns the full game, you can join them for the entire adventure for free. HERE'S HOW IT WORKS: 1. Own Split Fiction 2. Friend Downloads Friend’s Pass on chosen platform 3. Send invite to a friend 4. Play the entire game together! One minute you’re taming adorable dragons, and the next you’re fighting as cyber ninjas, escaping terrifying trolls, or dodging hover cars thrown by a robotic parking attendant. Split Fiction is weird, wild, and designed to be shared. Grab a friend and get ready to overcome any obstacle thrown your way. Jump into mind-blowing moments and experience the many worlds of Split Fiction, a boundary-pushing co-op action adventure from the studio behind 2021 Game of the Year Winner It Takes Two. Mio and Zoe are contrasting writers — one writes sci-fi and the other writes fantasy — who become trapped in their own stories after being hooked up to a machine designed to steal their creative ideas. They’ll have to rely on each other to break free with their memories intact, working together to master a variety of abilities and overcome diverse challenges while jumping between sci-fi and fantasy worlds in this unexpected story of friendship. KEY FEATURES: TRUE CO-OP ADVENTURE — This split-screen adventure is tailored for two. Experience co-op gameplay where you’ll have to coordinate your actions and timing as well as work together to overcome challenges. This wild ride comes to you from Hazelight, the co-op thrill-makers that brought you It Takes Two and A Way Out. UNPARALLELED VARIETY — Discover new mechanics and abilities in every level of your adventure, which will alternate between sci-fi and fantasy worlds. Escape a sun that’s going supernova, challenge a monkey to a dance battle, try out some cool hoverboard tricks, fight an evil kitty, and ride everything from gravity bikes to a sandshark. Experience worlds that are entirely different from each other, unexpected new abilities, and a range of gameplay that includes platforming, puzzles, and more. There are surprises waiting for you and your friend in every new level. THE POWER OF FRIENDSHIP — Mio and Zoe don’t get along at first, but soon enough they become each other’s only hopes. This journey will throw unexpected twists at them and if they want to make it through, they’ll need to have each other’s backs. They’ll encounter bizarre situations as they traverse stories born from their own wild imaginations. Most importantly – they’ll face it all together.
row.short_description: Invite a friend for free with the Friend's Pass and experience a mind-blowing co-op adventure together as you’re pulled deep into the many worlds of Split Fiction.
row.reviews: “contender for the best game of 2025.” 10/10 – GameSpot “Split Fiction is a co-op masterpiece.” 10/10 – GameReactor (UK) “the best co-op experience you can play today” 10/10 – Inverse

row.name: Morimens
row.detailed_description: 'Morimens' is a roguelite card-battling game set in a world inspired by the Cthulhu mythos. Within the game, you will connect with a diverse array of awaker, each with distinct personalities, to construct a unique strategic deck tailored to your playstyle. Venture into the misty expanse of the game's map, confront unpredictable events, savor the tactical thrill of card-based combat, and progressively unravel the bizarre and maddening truths that lie at the heart of your investigation. 【Worldview】 The world is dying, yet its inhabitants remain blissfully unaware. Confronted with a covert, indescribable calamity, you shall take on the role of Keeper, awakening powers intertwined with the very doom threatening existence. You will link yourself with anthropomorphic weapons teetering on the precipice of madness, to withstand this monumental crisis. If all is destined to be forgotten, would you bear the burden of secrets as testament to the world's existence, forging ahead into the unknown? May tombstones stand as evidence, and may the Silver Key guide our way. Welcome to Mythag University, Keeper. 【Game Features】 ● A unique art style, accompanied by a diverse cast of characters, and a plethora of designs derived from the Cthulhu mythos, catering to your eclectic tastes and preferences! ● Four fundamental realms serve as the game's backdrop, complemented by an ever-expanding library of over 185 cards, with more being added continually. This extensive array fosters a wealth of playstyles, offering both breadth and depth in strategic options. It empowers you to construct decks freely, reveling in the strategic delight of overcoming great odds with clever tactics! ● Lightweight rogue-lite, low barrier to entry, yet highly replayable! Get started effortlessly and enjoy endless gameplay variety! Map events, loot drops, card buffs, shop refreshes... each round presents a uniquely shifting battlefield with fresh surprises and challenges awaiting at every turn! Character progression outside of battles, deck building strategies, in-game death resistance mechanics, and quick-witted adaptability ensure a more manageable, relaxed, and user-friendly experience for newcomers! ● Heart-rending storylines accompanied by evocative soundtracks lead players through episodic narratives that gradually descend into the mad truth and the abyss, portraying a gallery of human nature amidst despair and the flickering light of hope. ● Engage in solo tower-climbing challenges that push your strategic thinking to the limit; meanwhile, the PvP mode subverts solo mode with brand-new card effects and mechanics. There's no need for prolonged character development – jump right in and enjoy the thrill of fair and balanced combat! A Message from the Development Team Thank you for venturing into the world of 'Morimens'! Nothing brings us greater joy than having you experience our game. If you enjoy 'Morimens' or have any feedback about your experience, please do share it with us! Though this world may be fraught with peril, we are delighted to have crossed paths. May the Silver Key guide our way.
row.short_description: Morimens is a roguelite card-building game inspired by the Cthulhu mythos, where you craft a versatile and intricate deck tailored to your playstyle. The choice is yours to embark on a climb up treacherous towers or engage in tactical battles. Explore misty maps and uncover the truth of the world.

row.name: Records of the Flycatcher
row.detailed_description: ... When you finally regain consciousness, you find yourself lying face down in the snow, with a long trail of footprints behind you. It seems you had collapsed from exhaustion.   You find yourself struggling to flip yourself over. When you eventually do, you find several newly acquired cuts and bruises all over yourself. You quickly administer some first aid, before spending a few minutes fiddling with your radio set. But as you expect, your frequencies remain silent.   On your back lies a small saving grace: a state-of-the-art imported bolt action sniper rifle, far superior to any domestically manufactured equivalent. You forgot exactly how it fell into your hands in the midst of the chaotic rout. And despite everything, part of you wished its previous owner was still alive.   Your chain of command has completely broken down. Hadrian soldiers are pouring across the eastern border in their tens of thousands, and you are one of the last few things standing between them and the defenseless villages across the vast Altheimian wilderness. In the absence of further orders, you have no choice but to conduct a fighting retreat by yourself. Quietly eliminiate Hadrian officers and agents. Set up ambushes, plan your attacks, and do everything in your power to slow down the enemy advance. Navigate through the vast Altheimian wilderness, trudging through terrain that may aid or hinder you. Encounter the occasional wildlife curious enough to approach your bonfire. Rendezvous with fellow soldiers. Exchange intel, or assist them if they are in trouble. Deal with any who had stepped out of line.  Encounter fellow Altheimians, resupply and rest in friendly villages, purchase their goods and services if needed. Help any remaining civilians flee the oncoming Hadrian onslaught, or ignore them to focus on your objectives.  Find abandoned items within the war-torn ruins that scatter the wilderness, and try not to get drunk from any leftover alcohol you find.  Try to balance your Sanity and personal well-being with the realities and necessities of war.
row.short_description: The empire of Hadria has turned its war machine against the vulnerable eastern hinterlands of Altheim. With only your sniper rifle on your back, and a few strips of rabbit meat in your pocket, you must defend the motherland and wage a lone guriella war against the overwhelming tide of invaders.

row.name: Dusty's Sweeping Cleanup
row.detailed_description: Dusty’s Sweeping Cleanup is an action and racing inspired experience about cleaning your way around the house. Take control of Dusty the Robot Vacuum and trace your own path in a variety of fast paced and open environments. This game was made in 15 weeks by a small group of students in Montréal, Canada. Features: Robot Movement: Boost, drift and jump with Dusty’s momentum-based movement. Robot Cleaning: Earn points by cleaning the floor and by sucking up a variety of objects in your environment. House-Based Levels: Clean your way through different rooms, each with their own unique layout and obstacles to overcome. Breaking objects: Break objects to create even more stuff to clean up! Collectibles: For the completionists, try to find all the special collectibles in each level. Secrets: Find hidden passages scattered around the house, with many secrets waiting to be revealed.
row.short_description: Clean your way around the house as a robot vacuum with this action and racing inspired experience!

row.name: マーダーミステリーＪ
row.detailed_description: ■ Everyone is a suspect!? Up to 12 players can compete online! Using the communication function of your device, you can compete online with up to 12 players anytime, anywhere, with anyone, and as many times as you want! ■ Ultimate suspense! Night actions determine life or death!! The murderer's goal is to wipe out the master's family in the mansion. Night after night, the murderer sneaks into rooms, attempting to assassinate the family. They kill indiscriminately, targeting anyone they encounter, even if they're not part of the family... And once again, the day turns to night. Will you stay in your room? Or will you make a desperate attempt to escape? ■ Innovative! Accusation system!! Make a judgment on your own and accuse the murderer. If you're correct, you can expel the murderer! However, if you mistakenly accuse someone else, you'll be expelled instead!! There's no room for mistakes! Listen carefully to people's statements and find the murderer! ■ Over 30 unique roles!! Various roles will disrupt your deductions! ■ Game Description This game is a chat-based mystery suspense game where players are divided into factions (family faction, murderer faction, and other factions) and compete against each other. ◆ Other notes ・ Prohibited acts Using usernames that violate public morals, delaying actions during online matches, etc., are prohibited acts as stipulated in the terms of use of this application. row.name: CAT'S DREAM
row.detailed_description: Q: At what point does a cat become a human? A. The cat is dreaming B. This is the adventure I've been waiting for to change my boring life! C. Cats are inherently human, and humans don't think they exist until they observe them D. The magical world invades reality! One leak of magic and all hell breaks loose I don't know. But I became my owner and she became me. Now that a cat turns into a human, isn't it normal for other weird things to happen? Such as Ahem, can't reveal the plot. In short, it is a cat disguised as a human, fun, one-day adventure story! 'If you don't change your attitude, you'll live the same life as you do now, no matter what opportunities come your way.' 'Well, don't think too much about it. Go and try it first.' 'She will be as happy a tree as you could ever hope for.' > Bizarre events intertwine with ordinary life, and the reasons behind Cat Meow's transformation into a human is waiting for you to discover! > Huh? Here's a puzzle. Solve it. What is it? - Solve the puzzle, find Song's diary , maybe you will know something. > Interesting NPCS! (ps: I love a character, here to avoid revealing the plot first, want to know can be asked me.) >Four endings, what is the life of Meow and Song after this day? (ps: There is an Easter egg behind the true ending // proud face //) > Cute kitten Meow prototype for the creator's kitten Journey( By the way, Journey and Song, their Chinese name '且行且歌' means 'to sing while walking'), the game has hidden Journey's photos (≧ω≦)/ (definitely not with private goods). > The story is based on the real experience of the creator (with some processing), I hope it will resonate with you.
row.short_description: CAT'S DREAM is a pixel-style puzzle game in which players take on the role of Cat Meow that turns into a human, on a fantasy one-day adventure. The reason for all this seems to have something to do with her owner Song...

row.name: Bushside Rangers: Chapter 1
row.detailed_description: SURVIVE THE HORRORS OF THE DESOLATE LAND. Bushside Rangers®: Chapter 1 is a first-person survival horror game that forces you to use your wits as you navigate through the dark, dreary depths of an abandoned nature park. ABOUT Play as the reluctant Vera, a young teen who breaks into the abandoned Bushside Rangers Nature Park to figure out what truly happened to cause it's closure five years prior. Since you last visited, nature has reclaimed it's territory, leaving only tainted memories of what once was. And yet after all of that, the parks' mascots are somehow still roaming around... and they are starving. Journey deep into the park as you desperately try to figure out what happened, scavenge for and manage your resources effectively, and stealth your way around the parks' many residents. It's a fight for survival, and you have to hope to god that you can truly escape. FEATURES: Explore the first part of a five chapter experience. The desolate park is your oyster, explore it to your hearts content but be cautious... Endure horrific encounters with the park's mascots, once spectacles to behold but now reduced to nothing but monsters that lurk around every corner, looking for you... starving... Plenty of collectables and achievements scattered throughout to quench the thirst of lore hunters or completionists. Be sure to keep a keen eye out on anything you may find!
row.short_description: Bushside Rangers®: Chapter 1 is a first-person survival horror game that forces you to use your wits as you navigate through the dark, dreary depths of an abandoned nature park.

row.name: Gothic Clicker
row.detailed_description: Gothic Clicker is an ARPG clicker with great possibilities to customise your character and his combat style. You were snatched from the clutches of death by the necromancer Zotania in order to help her gather the bones of chaos and rid the world of the red fog. Character An unconventional approach to character development offers 5 combat and 5 crafting branches, in each of which a flexible perk system awaits you. Whether it's cold weapons or wizardry, hunting or herbalism, or maybe all of them at once - it's up to you! Inventory and Crafting Upgrade weapons with minerals, brew potions, wear rings, armour and amulets. You can wear 10 rings at a time, and you can combine them to become Rings of Power. row.name: SHADOW PUPPET
row.detailed_description: Welcome to SHADOW PUPPET! A short horror game made by one guy in his free time. What to Expect This is a short, atmospheric horror game where you're forced to wander through your own memories, now completely devoid of life. Something follows you in the shadows, moving only when you do. Light is your only friend here. You can interact with parts of the environment physically, such as pulling open doors and picking up objects. Getting out won't be simple, as you'll have to solve a few simple puzzles along the way. When you die, things don't always stay the same This game features semi-procedural generation, so expect to come across multiple variations of areas upon restarting! There are no checkpoints, and the game can be completed in under half an hour. There are two difficulties, each with their own ending Once you complete it the first time, feel free to try again in Paranoia Mode, where you'll uncover the truth about your situation and how to break free for good.
row.short_description: A short horror game about wandering through vaguely familiar memories while something endlessly follows you. It moves when you do, and you need to get out before it catches up.

row.name: Watertime
row.detailed_description: Keeping yourself hydrated is important for your physical and mental health. I attributed my recent low mood and lack of energy to the fact that some days I entirely forget to drink any liquids... so I created this app to remind me to drink water throughout the day. I hope it can help you as well. Key Features Sits in the bottom right of your screen Blinks every several hours to remind you to drink Double-click to reset the blink timer Story Time I took a tumble down the stairs. Why? I was too shy to ask the teacher for a glass of water. I was very thirsty. I tried to force myself to ask for water, but I couldn't do it. By the end of the class I was seeing green spots in front of my eyes, and as we were leaving the classroom, I just fainted, falling like a sack of potatoes to the bottom of the stairs. They took me to the nurse who helped me out. Ever since then I've had trouble feeling thirsty, and my only signs are when dehydration symptoms start, such as dry mouth, gut problems, low energy, dry skin, low mood, you name it. This is why I made Watertime - to remind me to drink. Every two hours it starts to blink to remind me to have a drink. Once I've had some water, I can double-click it to let it know and reset the timer. I also made the timer configurable. Check it out and let me know what you think. QnA Can you adjust the timer? Yes, you can. Can it stay running alongside other steam games? Yes, it does not create any conflicts. Does it need Steam to run? No, but Steam needs to be open for achievements.
row.short_description: A simple reminder to help you drink more water during the day.

row.detailed_description: Embark on a quest to cure a plague that is bringing the land of Hajimari to its knees. Explore the land and uncover its many secrets while meeting the last of its inhabitants. Will you help Hajimari thrive, or doom it to wither away? STORY The four nations of Hajimari have been struck with a plague that has put the entire island in peril. All plant life has slowly started to die away, causing conflict between the Grizz, Faerials, Komurans, and Haji. Many people have lost their lives not only to the plague, but wars between the nations as well. The islanders tried praying to the gods they worship, but received no answer. Many have given up, and many say the gods are dead. All seemed hopeless, but sometimes hope can come from the most unsuspecting of spirits. Tamiko and her brother Kenshin reside in the village of Komura on the southwest side of Hajimari. They've witnessed their family and friends die from the plague and other islanders which has compelled them to find the source of the plague and destroy it. They will meet friends and enemies alike on their journey, including the highly intelligent Locke, the child prodigy thief Avadel, the banished maniac Drago, and the powerful grandma Zeniba. FEATURES Optional voice acting for the main story A unique EXP system that rewards actions rather than defeating enemies Hundreds of elemental armor and weapon combinations Open narrative design with a freely traversable world Unique and interesting side quests that build the world and setting A completely original soundtrack, sound effects included! Traditionally created paintings for story scenes Original art for all of the characters, enemies, and game icons A subtle karma system that affects the main character's personality and game endings Dynamic NPCs that follow their own schedule across four days in a day-night cycle ACCESSIBILITY Colorblind filters Dyslexic font Turn-based combat Keyboard/controller mapping White flash reduction

row.name: The Legend of Thabor - Rise of the Mages

row.name: The Final Act
row.detailed_description: Overview The Final Act is a mix of visual novel and puzzle game where you step into the shoes of Rebecca Carter, a writer struggling with a severe case of writer's block. Desperate to complete her latest novel, Rebecca seeks help from her mentor, Jessica. Together, they delve into crafting the perfect murder for Rebecca's protagonist, Reina, who must eliminate a blackmailer to save her husband's reputation. As players guide Rebecca through this intricate narrative, they must solve puzzles and piece together the perfect crime, blurring the lines between fiction and reality. Key Features Immersive First-Person Perspective : Experience the narrative up close as you assist Rebecca in crafting her story and solving intricate puzzles. Engaging Puzzle Mechanics : Adjust items, find clues, and draft scenarios to construct the perfect murder plot within Rebecca's novel. Dynamic Narration : The story adapts to your choices, providing a unique and personalized narrative experience. Narrative Inserts : Watercolor-style inserts that drive the story and reveal Rebecca's internal thoughts and creative process. Female Protagonist : Follow the compelling journey of Rebecca Carter as she battles writer's block and navigates the complex narrative of her novel. Detailed Description In The Final Act , you are drawn into the creative mind of Rebecca Carter, an aspiring writer facing the daunting challenge of finishing her latest novel. Struggling with writer's block, Rebecca turns to her mentor, Jessica, for guidance. Together, they work on the final act, where Rebecca's protagonist, Reina, must devise the perfect plan to murder a blackmailer threatening her husband's reputation. As you guide Rebecca through this creative process, you will meticulously craft the crime scene, find hidden clues, and interact with various items to build the perfect murder plot. The game’s unique puzzle mechanics allow you to adjust the initial positions of items such as doors, guns, knives, and more, to set up different scenarios. Each decision you make influences the drafts and leads to different endings, keeping you engaged as you strive to construct the perfect narrative. The narrative unfolds through dynamic storytelling and watercolor-style inserts, revealing Rebecca’s internal thoughts and creative struggles. The cute anime visual style contrasts sharply with the dark themes, creating a unique and unsettling atmosphere. As you delve deeper into Rebecca's novel, you’ll find yourself blurring the lines between her fiction and reality. Prepare yourself for an emotional and psychological journey in The Final Act , where every clue, every item, and every choice matters. Will you help Rebecca overcome her writer's block and craft the perfect ending to her story?
row.short_description: The Final Act is a mix of visual novel and puzzle game where you assist writer Rebecca Carter in overcoming her writer's block by crafting the perfect murder plot for her novel. Solve intricate puzzles, adjust crime scenes, and navigate immersive storytelling to uncover the perfect crime.

Tricky and fun cooperative multiplayer action in VR A mega-corporation beams you as a robot into a supposedly rosy future despite unchecked climate change. But rebels hack into the system to warn you: only together can you break through the propaganda machine, escape the corporation and save the world! Short and sweet - 25 to 30 minutes Experience the high-tech freight train of the mega-corporation E.V.I.L., overcome security, fight fossil drones and face the boss battle with the Juggernaut. With the influencers LeFloid & ItzJanina For the role of Vice President of E.V.I.L. The well-known german influencer and Youtuber LeFloid was won. Itzjanina, known from RocketBeans, hacks into the company network as the rebel Alena to help you. Features Cooperative VR multiplayer action adventure Save the future with action, teamwork and humor! Climate crisis meets science fiction meets satire Travel into the future with your friends, resist the mega-corporation's propaganda and hack into the network with the help of the rebels Grab a renewable energy pack and literally fight the causes of climate change Fun action with brains! Catch the drones with your solar beam like a lasso! Intelligent enemies - not only do they bombard you with oil, but they can also ram you and blow you away!  With the well-known influencers LeFloid & ItzJanina Fun-O-Calypse: Serious topic - fun look 1 - 4 players Playing time: 25 - 35 minutes Climate crisis meets science fiction meets satire The innovation project “GreenGuardiansVR” (GGVR) is a cooperation between the SWR X Lab and the Department of Economics and Environment. Following on from the topic “Climate lawsuits against ExxonMobil” from the KlimaZeit broadcast on August 9th, the game addresses the consequences of targeted disinformation from large corporations and how important it is to be able to distinguish fact from fiction.

row.name: Hail Britannia
row.detailed_description: Overview: Hail Britannia is a richly detailed text-based game set in an alternate history timeline where the Central Powers emerged victorious in the Great War, leading to significant geopolitical shifts worldwide. Players assume the role of a Canadian soldier who has to navigate through intricate storylines, engage in strategic combat, and interact with a diverse array of characters. The game features dynamic conversations and news events that shape the unfolding narrative, reflecting the political, social, and economic turmoil of this alternate 20th-century world. Gameplay Mechanics: Dynamic Dialogue Trees: Players can engage in branching conversations with NPCs, gaining information, and influencing relationships. Turn-Based Battles: Combat is strategic and turn-based, requiring players to make tactical decisions to defeat enemies. Class Choice: There are 3 combat classes: Foot Soldier, Combat Medic, and Tank Driver. World Events: The game's world unfolds through news events that reflect the changing political and social climates. Backstory: The timeline of Hail Britannia diverges from our own in 1917 when the Kaiser chose not to resume unrestricted submarine warfare or send the Zimmerman telegram. Without American intervention, the French military struggled to hold back the Germans and eventually collapsed under a German offensive, leading to their capitulation. With France surrendering, the Central Powers offered peace to the Entente, bringing an end to the Great War on November 11, 1919. Following a brutal war with no tangible gains, both France and the United Kingdom succumbed to communist rebellions. The French Commune and the Union of Britain were established, while the exiled governments fled to North Africa and Canada, respectively. As Britain fell, territories such as Gibraltar, Cyprus, and Malta were seized by other nations. New Zealand joined Australia, the British Raj split into the loyalist Raj and the independent Indian State, and South Africa voted to leave the Empire. The Caribbean colonies of Britain and France were annexed by Canada. In the unstable and violent decades since the Great War, the Soviet Union was proclaimed by Lenin in 1921 after defeating the White Army. However, former Russian territories like the Baltic Union, Lithuania, Belarus, Ukraine, and Poland fell under German occupation. China fractured into several regions, including the Republic of China, Soviet Mongolia, the Japanese puppet state of Manchukuo, and Tibet. Italy's post-war economic collapse fueled political extremism, leading to Benito Mussolini's rise and the establishment of a fascist dictatorship. In the Americas, Calvin Coolidge's presidency saw the 1925 crash of the New York Stock Exchange and the onset of the Great Depression, which primarily affected the Americas as the global economy now centered around the Berlin Stock Exchange. With war debts unpaid, the US economy declined for 19 years. Economic uncertainty led to the rise of communist and fascist regimes in Central and South America, leaving Canada, Costa Rica, and the US as the last bastions of democracy in the region. However, even the US remains fragile, with the Steel Belt witnessing a significant shift towards communism and fascist southerners aiming to recreate the Confederacy.
row.short_description: Hail Britannia is a text-based game with lite RPG elements set in an alternate 1944 where the Central Powers won World War 1.

row.name: Once Upon a Galaxy
row.detailed_description: Once Upon a Galaxy is a fast-paced, free-to-play card battler of cosmic proportions. Captain a crew of characters from myth and fairytale lore into battle across a spectacular galaxy in search of allies, spells, and treasures to ensure your ultimate victory! Begin each game by selecting a Captain with its own unique effect. Will you choose Dorothy to help complete her friends’ quests? Or Dragonmother to discover what hatches from her Mysterious Egg? Play as Indiana Clones to 'clone' your best three treasures, or lead a troupe of toys as Geppetto! More captains are released each month, so there’s always something new to try! Galaxy features an eclectic cast to help you on your journey. Recruit characters and cast spells each round to prepare for your next challenge. Carefully position your cards while planning your turn—then enjoy their auto-battle against other captains and crews! Upgrade your crew throughout the game. Character-copies give bonuses and discover powerful treasures. Enhance your board directly to keep buffs as you replace characters. The most powerful cards appear later in the game—find a Legendary crew to help make you the last captain standing! You can capably lead any odd character, but your most powerful crews will come from smartly-selected synergies. Combine treasure effects with characters’ abilities for powerful outcomes. Leverage powerful character factions, each with their own focus, such as treasure-loving Dragons, spell-enhanced Mages, or Toys which summon additional characters during the fight! In addition to the common pool of cards you encounter each game, each captain commands its own list of collectible elite characters to customize your plans. Select 12 cards before the game—they’ll be mixed into your card pool to potentially draw! No timers, no pressure. Galaxy's matchmaking and async-multiplayer mean you can battle fun-but-challenging opponents whenever you want. Face real boards from other human players’ earlier games. Your finished run will join the opponent pool for others to challenge. It's fast, strategic, and endlessly fun! When you're ready to crank up the intensity, you can play with friends in 6-player live lobbies... warning: live lobbies are the ultimate competitive experience! While our Steam build is great for the desktop experience, Galaxy is also available on your phone or tablet! With a cross-platform account, you can sync your progress no matter which device you use and so can explore Galaxy on-the-go! Once Upon a Galaxy is created by Million Dreams Games, an indie studio boasting a talented team. Our leads have worked on iconic games like Magic: The Gathering , Hearthstone , and Runeterra . We’re diehard fans of the card and auto-battler genres. We believe in building a fully-functional free-to-play experience. We partner with wonderful artists to bring our vision to life (no AI artwork is used in Galaxy ). If you love our game too (we think you will!) and want to support us, you can boost your collection rewards or style your favorite cards with alternate-art skins. A monthly Galaxy Pass offers both! Give Galaxy a try and experience the thrill of this groundbreaking card battler.

row.name: Dark Hours: Prologue
row.detailed_description: WISHLIST THE FULL GAME About the Game Dark Hours: Prologue is a free version of Dark Hours. Experience the core gameplay and get a taste of the experience that awaits in the full game. Dark Hours is a co-op survival horror game for 1-4 players. Just when you think you've pulled off the perfect heist, your break-in is suddenly interrupted by an unexpected supernatural event. You find yourself trapped in the auction house you came to rob and you realize with horror that you are no longer alone... A demonic creature has taken over the place and you have become its new prey. Will you manage to escape? Will you survive this apocalyptic night? PROLOGUE FEATURES: The Auction House: Explore the area in search of a way out, solve co-op minigames, deactivate lasers and security cameras, fill your bag with valuable loot, and take advantage of the building's secrets to get out of there. New monsters: Encounter up to 2 creatures, each with distinct behaviors and unique abilities. Unique items and co-op action to make your heist a success. KEY FEATURES Cooperate: Dark Hours is a 1-4 player cooperative experience where you must work together to escape the evil entity that is hunting you. You can't survive alone, stay close to your teammates and collaborate to find your way out of this nightmare. Manage your equipment: A lock-picking set, a hacking device, a flashlight or a crowbar? Pick your gear and find all sorts of items during your exploration. Use them wisely with your teammates and you may have a chance to get out alive. Or not… Escape or survive: There are only two ways out: find the exit or hide from the creature until morning. Will you make it through this dreadful night? GAMEPLAY FEATURES Steal: Remember, your first objective is to rob this place, so make sure to steal every valuable item you find. Score big! Best Thieves: Carrying all that illegally-acquired loot can be tiring for your friends, so don't hesitate to discreetly offer your help by emptying their bags to steal the most precious items. There is no honor among thieves! Be stealthy: Don’t make too much noise or the monster will find you. Be careful: the more you loot, the louder you get. In case of extreme urgency, you can (sneakily) fill your teammates' bags so they are noisier than you. Survive: Seek refuge wherever you can or push your teammate to the entity's clutches. Survival justifies any action. Between us, it's better him than you, right? Live a terrifying and fun co-op horror experience where you will discover more about the origin of the dark hours! …and who your friends really are! Warning This game contains flashing lights that may make it unsuitable for people with photosensitive epilepsy or other photosensitive conditions. Player discretion is advised.
