Kakuro++
row.detailed_description: More than 800 grids of the best puzzle-game available. Kakuro (also called Kakkuro, kakro, cross sums or カックロ), is a logic game that consists of filling in a grid of numbers, in the same way as a crossword puzzle. If you enjoyed Sudoku logic, you'll love Kakuro's puzzles As with Sudoku, the rules of Kakuro are simple and can be learned in a few minutes. All you need to do is make simple additions to put your logic to the test. Kakuro Plus offers 16 different game levels and 50 puzzles per level: It will probably take you more than a couple of hundred hours, and a lot of logic to get these 800 puzzles finished. As with Sudoku or crosswords, each puzzle has a unique solution. It is up to you to find it using your logic and perspicacity. This version of Kakuro ++ allows you : • To access all the 800 Kakuro puzzles. • To begin and progress, some puzzles have been specially designed for beginners. Their small size and difficulty levels is suitable for first-time players. • To access grids of any level. The 15 game levels provide a smooth progression, from beginner to logic expert. • Annotate the table, to record assumptions and move forward in complicated cases. • To go back: there is a 'UNDO' button to cancel up to 100 actions. Don't be afraid to test your assumptions anymore. • To enjoy high definition graphics for maximum readability. This version of Kakuro ++ adds unique features: • A help system, which offers you several possibilities: • Check if your grid has errors, without showing them to you. This allows you to remove a doubt, without providing you with the solution. • Show you where the mistakes are. • Give you a hint, which will allow you to move forward in difficult cases. • A visualization of all possible combinations of a clue. A color set shows you the possible logical values. The Kakuro rules: • Your goal is to fill in the grid with numbers from 1 to 9 like a crossword puzzle. • The clues tell you the amount to be reached in each group of horizontal or vertical boxes. • As with Sudoku or crosswords, you will win when the game board is fully filled, without any mistakes. Feel free to send me your comments so that future versions will be even more attractive.

row.name: RMP: Role Music Player
row.detailed_description: We want to take different musical languages around the world closer to storytellers and RPG players. The Role Music Player (RMP) is an interactive audio controller application that allows sound manipulation in different layers aiming to offer to users a total control of volume and density. All that in an organic and continuous way. In the application it is possible to load different themed packages called “Dimensions”. Each one has 5 musical themes, 5 ambient sounds and 10 stingers (short sounds for pontual and important moments in the narrative). Every “Dimension” explores a specific subgenre that exists into a broader context like Dungeons and Dragons, Cyberpunk and Call of Cthulhu. All directed to the universe of Role Playing Games and to storytellers, our main public. RMP’s great differential is the possibility to control the music density in real time, allowing the narrator to keep their voice present (without the need to lower the audio volume) and at the same time as they collaborate to create narrative moments either intense or calm. C O L L A B O R A T I V E   P R O J E C T  Storytelling is fueled by different cultures that we have around the world as they are rich and extremely diverse. Fiction is inspired in real stories and so is the contrary. In this context the Role Music Player looks into approaching these different cultures in the means of a collaborative musical production project in which the artist is at the center of distribution and everything they bring to the table is welcomed. We believe that for every story there is a unique soundtrack hidden somewhere out there and the Role Music Player aims to be the bridge in which this soundtrack is discovered and reaches storytellers. Every single one of these interactive albums will be signed by a specific artist and will be called “Dimension” inside the RMP. S T A C K I N G   L A Y E R S Storytelling impacts us by its capacity to vary emotion and subdue expectations. In this sense the RMP offers to each one of its “Dimensions” 5 different musical themes to accompany the nuances in each narrative and maintain the instrumental and originality between the themes. D E N S I T Y   C O N T R O L This project’s grand differential is the possibility to control the density of each musical theme, allowing that the immersion provided by the musical tracks don’t lose themselves but also adapt to each narrator’s style. Using the low density setting makes it not necessary to lower the volume of the music as it tends to overshadow the narration. At the same time, it is possible to reserve the high density settings to epic moments in the narration. The density control was developed through the manipulation of the quantity of instruments and the application of dynamic filters that allow the users a broad gama of immersion possibilities. N E X T   U P D A T E S D0001: 20XX Explore a chaotic future with grand settings and challenging battles. Free Dimension (DLC) - Genre: Cyberpunk - Composer: Arlam Junior D0002: Grand Adventure Enter a fantastic world filled with creatures, mystical beings, and dangerous adventures. Free Dimension - Genre: D&D - Composer: Vinicius Meireles D0003: Fangs and Masks Be part of the underground nightlife of the big capital and discover what really goes on behind the curtains. Paid Dimension (DLC)  - Genre: Vampire:The Masquerade - Composer: Dan Bariani D0004: Epic Dungeons   Embark on a medieval adventure facing epic challenges. Paid Dimension (DLC)  - Genre: D&D - Composer: Franklly Thallyson D0005: New Paths for Travellers   Lead a small group of explorers in the search for new worlds. Paid Dimension (DLC)  - Genre: D&D - Composer: Arlam Junior D0006: March of the Dwarves   Experience the mining culture of the mountain dwarves, with their marches designed to withstand the pace of their heavy work. Paid Dimension (DLC)  - Genre: D&D - Composer: Vinicius Meireles D0007: The Call   Embark on an environmental horror tale set in the United States of the 1920s. Paid Dimension (DLC)  - Genre: Call of Cthulhu - Composer: Dan Bariani D0008: Gothic Punk   Embark on a retro dystopian world full of intrigue and new technologies. row.name: Master of Shotgun Camper
row.detailed_description: Good news for those of you who are always 'Shotgun Camper'(Corner Camper) in FPS games. This game is a PvE game dedicated to aiming and shooting enemies that emerge from corners. Each round lasts less than 10 seconds. It requires split-second concentration and delicate aiming skills. Show off your corner camping and pre-aiming skills to your heart's content. This game is all about pre-aiming. I aimed to capture the thrill you get when you take down an enemy that jumps out at you in a tactical FPS, with micro flicks and lightning-fast reaction times. Weapons include not just shotgun, but also AR, SMG, and Sniper. There are also Steam rankings (high scores, total kills, etc.), an achievement feature, and an endless mode. Stage-based progression lets you enjoy a variety of situations, such as close range, long range, peeking from cover, and simultaneous multi-directional appearances. It's not only fun as a standalone game but also great for practicing your pre-aiming skills. The game will not have an Early Access period, but I will be updating the game from time to time with difficulty adjustments, additional content, bug fixes, etc.

row.name: Snowfall Symphony - A tale of Crustallus
row.detailed_description: Overview On a snowy night, you awaken with blurry memories in an unfamiliar place. Your hair has mysteriously turned white. Seeking refuge, you make your way to the nearest town, only to be betrayed and cast into peril. As a forbidden vampire spawn, survival is your utmost priority. Who will aid you in your first days of this dark new existence? Who can you trust? And who will you manipulate to ensure your survival? Discover the secrets, face the dangers, and navigate the treacherous path with multiple endings in 'Snowfall Symphony - A Tale of the Crustallus'. Main characters Meet Mina, our protagonist. One night, she awakens as a vampire with a blurry memory and white hair. Now, she must navigate this unfamiliar world and decide who to trust. Along her journey, she might find a powerful friend, fall in love, or choose to betray those she meets. The path she takes is up to you. Charlie is a seasoned vampire who isn't afraid to bend the truth or manipulate others if it serves his purposes. While he may appear untrustworthy, his skills and resources could make him a valuable ally for you. Proceed with caution, though, as his loyalty may shift depending on what benefits him most. Hans, a relatively young vampire, inherited his family's fortune, propelling him into wealth and power. Unlike many of his kind, he chooses to collaborate closely with humans and appears to disdain the brutality of vampire society. However, while he may seem like a potential protector against other vampires, there could be ulterior motives lurking beneath his facade of benevolence. Are his intentions truly noble, or does he harbor a secret agenda? Meet Reina, an ancient and enigmatic vampire who has weathered numerous hardships throughout her long existence. Possessing formidable power and wisdom, she is a sought-after ally. However, gaining her trust is no easy feat, as her standards are exceedingly high. Can you prove yourself worthy of her allegiance and bring her to your side, or will her elusive nature remain beyond your grasp? Features This horror visual novel is primarily aimed at women, though of course all genders are welcome to play! Visual Novel with Multiple Routes: Experience 3 main routes, each leading to one of 19 different endings. Many ways to die: certain decisions can lead to the death of your main character or other main characters – nobody is safe in this game. Choice-Driven Outcomes: Each route offers 4 main endings, influenced by your decisions and your affection levels with certain characters. Romantic Potential: Engage with 4 potential romance partners. Beware, in a vampire world, romance is not paramount and might not lead to a happy ending. Roughly 48.000 words and about 1h reading time per route
row.short_description: After awakening as a forbidden vampire spawn, you're thrown into a cruel world where survival is not guaranteed. Who will you choose as your ally — and will you survive, or betray them yourself? Find out in this horror romance visual novel!

row.name: Literally Just Pixels On A Screen
row.detailed_description: Welcome to Literally Just Pixels On A Screen . In this 'game' you get to collect pixels. That's it. Leave the game open and every hour you will be dropped a random pixel. Different pixels have different drop rates. Pixels will appear as items in your Steam inventory, are tradable, and can be bought/sold on the Steam Community Market. You can also craft 10 pixels into a single random pixel. Drop rates for each pixel: Each pixel is in 12-bit RGB color space and can be represented by 3 hex digits, one for each R, G, and B value. Each digit (0 - F) represents a number between 0 and 15. Each pixel is generated by essentially simulating a sequence of 45 coin flips. The number of heads in the first 15 coin tosses determines the R value, the number of heads in the next 15 coin tosses determines the G value, and the number of heads in the final 15 coin tosses determines the B value. This results in some absurdly rare pixels, like #000 and #FFF (the pure black/white pixels) that each have a probability of 1 : 35184372088832 to be dropped. The pixels #00F, #0F0, #0FF, #F00, #F0F, #FF0 also have the same probability of being dropped. Good luck collecting all the pixels.

Duren, Prince of Tyraca Zuleika's childhood friend, Nefferon's angel, and now prince of Tyraca, but he is anything but proud of his new position. He is generally polite and mild-mannered... except when he gets angry. Kirile, 'Prince' of Pyralis He was once a proud general from the demon nation of Pyralis, but took up thievery after being exiled. He loves women, booze, and having fun, but he has a sentimental side as well. Nefferon, Emperor The new emperor and a dangerous man who will do anything to get what he wants. He has a cool and collected demeanor, and can charm and manipulate his way into anyone's heart. Originally released in October 2010.

row.name: Digital TableTops Player
row.detailed_description: This virtual table top (VTT) is designed specifically for in-person play on a TV or monitor. Built from the ground up for use on a touchscreen. You will not find a VTT that is easier to use or your money back! That's a joke, it's completely free. There is no logging in, signing up, or any other strings attached. I make money selling hardware. If you would like to support this project, please consider buying a touchscreen or TV frame from me on my website . It is meant to replace dry erase or paper maps, but not replace any of the other aspects to playing in person. For example, there are no character sheets or dice rolls. Whatever tools you use, including pencil and paper, you should continue to use. Keeping only essential features makes this VTT the easiest to use. You place physical minis directly on the screen and digital tokens automatically keep track of their movement and lighting. Players who can't be there in person can join via their web browser to move their tokens. No fiddling around with network settings, just enter the 4-digit code and you are good to go. Features Import any image, video (for animated maps), or uvtt (aka dd2vtt) file with built-in line of sight data Dynamic lighting with fog of war, shadows, and time of day Over 440 free maps are included Built-in library of over 500 tokens or import your own custom tokens One-of-a-kind touchscreen support (interacts directly with the hardware) Remote control tokens via any browser Add/remove walls, doors, and windows to any map Easy map scaling and grid overlay Collision detection to prevent movement into unexplored areas Measuring tools for movement, distance, and spell effects Blazingly fast on any hardware thanks to the Godot engine. No dedicated graphics required Runs locally offline Easily import maps Foundry modules Initiative tracker Coming Soon Import external lighting More grid options (eg. hex) Weather effects If you are looking for a VTT exclusively for online play, this is not it. Hybrid play does work well, but it is required that the main program be running on a dedicated (low-end) device. If you are already using Foundry, Arkenforge, or Owlbear Rodeo and get along just fine, probably not a great idea to switch. But if you are just getting started out with VTT's and play in person, I honestly do believe this is an excellent choice. Please bring up any questions, problems, or feature requests in the community links so that all may benefit.
row.short_description: This virtual table top (VTT) is designed specifically for in-person play on a TV or monitor. Easily import maps into your library, format them, and add them to your campaign. Maps are then displayed along with fog of war, digital tokens, grid overlay, and more.

row.name: Idle Game Simulator
row.detailed_description: This is a very serious and in-depth simulator game which makes you really feel like you're playing an idle game! Feel the dopamine as you watch number go up, leisurely make yourself a cup of coffee or a sandwich while the game plays itself, and bask in the euphoria knowing that you now have a number that is larger than it was 1 second ago. Now with achievements for some reason. NEW UPDATE: Offline progress! Now the game doesn't even have to be running to make progress! Truly this is the idle game of all time. This is what everyone looks for in an idle game.
row.short_description: Have you ever wanted an idle game without all the pesky obstructions like gameplay and graphics? Introducing Idle Game Simulator! Is it a game? No, it is a very serious and deep simulator. This is idle in its purest form, watch number go up without having to do anything at all!

row.name: Click the Chick
row.detailed_description: Click the Chick! Meet an adorable chick in this wholesome clicker game! Living on your screen, your feathered friend generates eggs for you to click and collect. Enjoy the cheerful company of your chick. Cheep cheep cheep! Click the Chick is a minimalistic relaxing desktop companion pet clicker idle collectible egg farming game. The revolutionary genre of clicking on a bunch of pixels is among us and we are proud to present you with a ground-breaking game that builds on revolutionary mechanics that are hand-tailored for the player's needs. Chick the Click? Are you ready to click the Chick? This game offers unique, never-seen gameplay action that will completely immerse you as the player into chicken clicking! Click the chick while you play, click it when you eat, and click it even with two hands! Have you ever wondered how one can click the chick without hands? Use your feet and click the chick! row.name: Pierrot à la Mode
row.detailed_description: Welcome to your first day on the job, new guy. Here at Dairy Clown, we strive ourselves on quick, efficient service -- that's why our ice cream moves across a conveyor belt! Get ready to serve dish after dish, all while wearing a smile on your face (or a frown, it doesn't matter as long as it's painted on)! Take control of the New Guy during his first few days at the local clown-owned ice-cream parlor, Dairy Clown . Create frozen concoctions for your customers by applying toppings as the ice-cream goes whizzing past on a conveyor belt -- but watch out for Clown Mode , which will cause everything to shift around and speed up! This game uses photographs taken with a Game Boy Camera for character portraits and some key graphics, and was built in the span of 2 weeks for the Big Mode Game Jam . This new version contains numerous bugfixes and a new ending variation if you receive a perfect score across all 3 days of the story. Pierrot à la Mode features a runtime of approximately 15-20 minutes, three different endings, and will give you a small glimpse of what life was like in Divinity City before the Upgrade Virus hit. Enjoy a bite-sized look at Elyris and its strange inhabitants in this precursor to Gas Station Story !

On this continent full of the unknown, ancient ruins, mysterious pavilion, and forgotten castles—every corner may hide danger or treasure. 'West Journey' is not just a game; it is an adventure, an exploration of the unknown world, a journey of the soul. row.name: Blade of God X: Orisols
row.detailed_description: The Official Release is NOW! Your adventure awaits! Starting now, logging into the game will grant you exclusive rewards for free! BOGX emerges from the shadows as a captivating dark-themed Action RPG crafted, marking a thrilling continuation of the Blade of God saga. From Game, Beyond Game. Inheritor, the gods lie vanquished in twilight— You stand as the last sentinel. World Creation Rooted in Norse mythology, players assume the role of an 'Inheritor,' reborn through the cycles, and embark on a journey from Muspelheim to explore the vast realms supported by the World Tree. By traversing the timelines of Voidom, Primglory, and Trurem, players have the choice of 'Sacrifice' or 'Redemption,' allowing them to acquire artifacts or seek the assistance of hundreds of deities, including Odin the Allfather and Loki the Evil, to shape the progression of the world. Inheritor, the gods annihilated in the dusk — You, are the ultimate guardian. Dynamic Combos & Skill Chain Building upon the exhilarating combos from Blade of God I, we have introduced enhanced strategic depth to combat. The integration of counterattacks with skill chains empowers players to analyze the behavioral patterns and attack sequences of diverse bosses. Seizing the opportune moments when they are stunned or staggered, players can unleash focused attacks, making great damage. Unique Concept, Soul Core System Hela, who had nothing left to lose; Esther, who left her past behind; Chaos, who abandoned the physical form. Embedding the soul cores of monsters into the skill chain allows the protagonist to harness the power of souls in combat. Paired with the protagonist's professional features to find out limitless possibilities for the style of combat. Multiplayer Cooperation & Collaborative Confrontation Hand of corruption, assist horn, and invading. Engage in collaborative battles, compete for rewards, and execute cunning strategies. Form or join a Caravan, participate in genuine and fair PvP, and collaborate to conquer formidable bosses. Ultimate Visuals & Musical Experience Available on PC, Android, and iOS with synchronized updates, enjoy the best visual performance with support for up to 4K resolution. Immerse yourself in a symphonic experience crafted in collaboration with the Philharmonic Orchestra, providing an unparalleled musical journey. From the producer Each of us has sacrificed something invaluable for what we needed in that moment. Love? Freedom? Health? Time? In retrospect, is what we gained truly more precious than what we lost? This game aims to take you on a journey of sacrifice and redemption, where you can uncover your own answers.
row.short_description: BOGX emerges from the shadows as a captivating dark-themed Action RPG, marking a thrilling continuation of the Blade of God saga. From Game, Beyond Game. Inheritor, the gods lie vanquished in twilight— You stand as the last sentinel.

row.name: 5 Crowns
row.detailed_description: When crowns tremble, blades rise. The kingdom of Bianké is crumbling. Behind the golden halls, the king’s succession promises to be soaked in blood. Nobles arm themselves in silence, princes move their pawns… and the enemies of the realm no longer wait. In this creeping chaos, you play as Athéo , a commoner with no title, driven by the desperate need to save the one who remains . He leads the Amethyst Fangs , a mercenary company bound by a strict code of honor, soon caught in the storm of war. But 5Crowns doesn’t follow just one banner. You’ll traverse multiple fronts, witness conflicting truths, and command heroes with diverging ideals – all caught in the downfall of a collapsing kingdom. A forgotten duchy rises in the mountains. A young princess, sidelined by the court, tries to make her voice heard. At her side, a duchess forged by exile and war gives her more than shelter: an army, a hope, and a land ready to defy the laws of the realm. Among the nobles, others rise. Agraé , heir of the Fox, walks the tightrope between loyalty and truth. Goldy , a marquise marked by a broken oath, follows the shadows of her past through the Obsidian Blades. Around them, young knights and heirs question everything: should they still serve the crown… or prepare for its fall? And in the silence of cathedrals, another war brews. For while Éonn still guides the faithful, others whisper the promises of Nyx . Forbidden cults awaken. Old beliefs falter. And faith, like power, becomes a battlefield. ⚔️ GAMEPLAY Turn-based Tactical RPG : every mistake could cost you dearly. Plan, position, and outsmart your enemies. 25 base classes, 88 unique promotions : from lancers and fire mages to mounted units and feral Emeriths who fight with tooth and claw – every character follows a personal path. Create squads with powerful synergies. Permanent death : a fallen hero is a story lost… forever. Narrative support system : dialogue, deepen bonds, unlock unique abilities – because attachment can become a weapon. Progressive difficulty : accessible, demanding, and unforgiving. Each victory brings a new war. Every sacrifice leaves a mark... 💖 WHY YOU’LL LOVE IT An original epic : inspired by the golden age of Fire Emblem , but built on a dark and flamboyant new world. A demanding but rewarding tactical experience : complete freedom to build your teams, dozens of classes, and thoughtful challenges that reward smart play. An orchestral soundtrack : from martial choirs to melancholic ballads and sparks of hope. A love letter to classic tactical RPGs : familiar mechanics reimagined, hidden tributes, puzzle-like boss fights – fans will recognize the legacy. Memorable characters : every woman and man under your banner has a name, a past, a future… or a grave. Version Beta : 1.0
row.short_description: When crowns tremble and oaths shatter, Bianké ignites. Gather your allies, wield steel and cunning, and lead the Amethyst Fangs in a tactical RPG where every decision forges the story… or dooms it.

row.name: 随缘修仙
row.detailed_description: 传说在遥远的东方，人们御空飞行，手握仙器，潇洒地穿梭在云层之上。我自幼就幻想着想自己能像传说中的仙人一样，那是我对自由和飞翔的终极追求。 在一次偶然的山林探险中，我踏进了一片古老森林的深处，那里雾气缭绕，古木参天，仿佛是人间与仙境的交界。就在我即将迷失方向之际，一道柔和的光芒吸引了我的注意。我跟随那光芒，来到了神秘的山洞里，发现了一本的破旧的书和几张卡片。我拿起那本残旧的书籍，拍拍上面的灰尘，“随缘修仙”四个大字展示在我面前。这本《随缘修仙》记载着无数修士的成仙历程，这几张卡片叫机遇卡，能够帮助修士吸收天地精华。我知道，我的人生要开启副本了。 接下来的日子里，我就像是个疯狂的修炼机器。借助机遇卡，我吸收天地之气，练就了一身 “内功”。经历了几次差点挂掉的生死考验后，我终于在一次天劫中，像是打了个大 BOSS，我赢了！醒来时，我感觉自己全身都是力量，像是装了个新电池，无敌了！那个清晨，霞光万丈，我站在山顶，深呼吸，闭上眼，再睁开时 —— 哇塞，我飞起来了！我御空飞行，云雾是我的舞台，那一刻，我成了自己梦想中的仙人。 我还在路上，仗剑走天涯，每一步都充满探险，每个转角都可能遇到新的奇迹。这就是我的修仙旅程，不仅有趣，还充满了无限的可能。现在，我想要邀请你，与我一同踏上这条修仙之路。你是否听到了内心深处的呼唤？是否渴望着御风而行，探索那遥远的仙界？是否愿意放下尘世的纷扰，追求心灵的自由与超脱？ 你，准备好了吗？请拿起你的勇气，开启你的修仙之旅。在这条路上，每一个人都有可能成为传说，而你，或许就是下一个。 《随缘修仙》上卷：入门篇 机遇卡牌 ：玩家通过抽取机遇卡来获得修炼资源和方法。每种机遇卡都拥有独特的属性和技能，当特定组合的机遇卡相遇时，将触发强大的特殊效果，助力玩家快速提升修为。 修炼系统 ：玩家可以在不同的修炼场景中进行修炼，每次修炼都会随机获得机遇卡，每次渡劫成功都会奖励法宝。随着修为的提升，玩家可以解锁更多的游戏内容和功能，比如：点亮各种法宝、灵宠系统，角色系统。这会让玩家变得更加强大。 《随缘修仙》下卷：秘诀篇 特殊效果组合 ： 特色功能 ：玩家可以探索不同的机遇卡组合，发现稀有且强大的特殊效果。这些效果可能在修炼中提供巨大帮助或在渡劫中助你一臂之力。 法宝与灵宠 ： 法宝 ：玩家可以在游戏中收集各种法宝，法宝可以增强角色的修炼效率。 灵宠 ：灵宠是玩家的忠实伙伴，它们拥有独特的技能，可以帮助玩家在修炼取得优势。 渡劫历练 ： 每修炼 5 次，玩家将面临一次渡劫历练。这是对玩家角色实力的一次全面考验，成功渡劫后，角色将会获得质的飞跃，变得更加强大，同时奖励法宝道具。 自由探索 ： 游戏世界设定丰富，玩家可以在其中自由探索不同机遇卡牌组合，发现隐藏的秘境和故事。 《随缘修仙》番外篇   《随缘修仙》 以独特的机遇卡牌系统为核心，结合丰富的修炼养成玩法，为玩家打造了一个既充满挑战又充满惊喜的修仙世界。玩家将在游戏中体验真正的修炼之旅，通过各种特色功能和丰富的游戏内容，逐步成长为一代仙宗。   这款游戏的吸引力在于其深度策略性和高度自由度，让每个玩家都能在修仙的道路上找到属于自己的独特乐趣。 关于《随缘修仙》   欢迎体验我们【天下大同】首款游戏力作！这款游戏汇聚了团队成员的心血与热情，我们诚挚地希望它能为您带来无尽的乐趣。作为我们的第一步，我们深知还有许多需要改进和优化的地方。因此，我们迫切希望广大玩家朋友们能多提宝贵意见，共同见证这款游戏的成长。    为了更好地聆听大家的声音，我们特别建立了游戏交流群（社区群ID:45280449），欢迎各位玩家加入！在这里，你可以畅所欲言，与同好们交换游戏心得，共同探讨游戏中的点点滴滴。我们的团队会密切关注群内动态，认真倾听每位玩家的建议。    此外，若你在这段旅程中感受到了游戏的魅力，有能力的话，不妨多支持下我们的充值服务。你的支持是我们前进的动力，也将帮助我们不断优化游戏，为大家带来更丰富的游戏体验。   让我们一起携手，共创美好游戏世界！期待在游戏群中与你相遇，共同交流，共同进步！ 关于 天下大同 天下大同 是一个充满活力、激情与创意的初创游戏开发工作室。我们的宗旨是为玩家们打造一个高品质的游戏体验空间。期待与玩家共同成长，共创美好回忆。
row.short_description: 自幼心中藏着一个修仙梦，渴望有朝一日能御剑乘风，漫步云端，仗剑走天涯。在一次偶然的山林探险中，我意外发现了一本古老的修炼秘籍《随缘修仙》，从此踏上了梦寐以求的修仙之路。在无数个寒来暑往中，我潜心修炼，渡过九死一生的天劫，终于在一个霞光万丈的清晨，我，成仙啦！

row.name: Heart Of The Abyss
row.detailed_description: In Heart of the Abyss, you assume the role of the Sea Watcher, a guardian awakened to confront a mysterious and malevolent force corrupting the ocean's depths. This dark power warps marine creatures into monstrous abominations, threatening the balance of the underwater world. Your mission is to halt its insidious spread and restore peace to the abyss. This top-down hack-and-slash adventure, inspired by the challenging gameplay of Souls-like titles, demands both determination and skill. As the Sea Watcher, you will navigate treacherous underwater environments, battle hordes of corrupted sea creatures, and face formidable bosses. Each encounter tests your combat prowess and strategic thinking, requiring you to master your abilities and adapt to the ever-changing threats of the deep. With atmospheric visuals, intense combat, and a rich, immersive storyline, Heart of the Abyss offers a thrilling and challenging experience for action RPG fans. Dive into the depths, embrace the role of the Sea Watcher, and fight to reclaim the ocean from the clutches of corruption. ESMA Game section - student project 2023 : Game programming : Brieux CAQUELIN 3D Animation / VFX / Cinematics : Alexis HENG 3D Animation / Concept art / 2D : Jonas CHAMPOIRAL Chara modeling / 3D modeling : Anaïs BISCARAS 3D Modeling / Texturing : Corentin HABIB VFX : Mickaël FLAESCH-PERREAU Level design / Level Art / Rigging : Romain COUTELLIER Sound design : Julien PAWLOWSKI Sound design : Valentin CHEVRIER Sound design / Musical composition : Theo CLAVEL Musical composition : Matei POUZET
row.short_description: In Heart of the Abyss, you play as the Sea watcher, who has been awakened following the emergence of a mysterious and dangerous force that corrupts the depths. Your role will be to find a way to halt its progression as it possesses creatures and turns them into monstrous beings.

row.name: GawaiiGo
row.detailed_description: 'Gawaii Go' is an exciting multiplayer online hide-and-seek game that lets you enjoy the thrill of competition. The game features two roles: Hunters and Hiders. Hiders must disguise themselves as various objects in the environment, cleverly avoiding the Hunters’ search until the game ends. Meanwhile, Hunters need sharp observation skills and intelligence to identify and capture the Hiders. As the game progresses, you'll discover ingenious hiding spots and intense chases, making the entire experience full of tension and excitement. Challenge your stealth and detection abilities now and join your friends in this unparalleled hide-and-seek competition!
row.short_description: A battle of hiding and seeking, masterful disguises and clever captures—all in《Gawaii Go》!

row.name: Reload - ein interaktives Abenteuer
row.detailed_description: 'Reload' ist kein gewöhnliches Spiel, sondern ein interaktiver Kurzfilm, welcher innerhalb eines Semesters gedreht und in Unity in ein spielbares Erlebnis verpackt wurde. Entscheidungen sind zeitbasiert und werden mit One-Click-Buttons getätigt. Jede Entscheidung hat eine andere Auswirkung und beeinflusst den Ausgang der Geschichte. Folge Donnie auf seinem Weg durch die Genrewelten, flüchte vor dem Regierungsdoktor und suche nach dem Wiederstand. In einem Universum, in dem verschiedene Filmgenre als Welten nebeneinander existieren, hält ein autoritäres Regime die Grenzen dieser Welten in einem eisernen Griff. Niemand darf unerlaubt in ein anderes Genre elapsieren. Diejenigen, die es doch versuchen, werden schnell durch die Sprunginterferenzen aufgespürt und einer gründlichen Erinnerungslöschung unterzogen. Nun ist es doch jemandem gelungen, ein Sprunggerät zu entwickeln, welches es dem Träger möglich macht, vollkommen unerkannt in andere Genre zu springen. Der Name dieses Erfinders war Donnie. Blöderweise wurde Donnie auf seinem Weg zum Wiederstand durch ein Missgeschick von der Regierung gefasst und steht nun kurz vor der Erinnerungslöschung. Doch Hilfe ist bereits auf dem Weg: Sowohl der Wiederstand als auch andere Gruppen haben Wind von Donnie's Erfindung bekommen und möchten diese in ihren Händen wissen. Wird Donnie sicher beim Wiederstand ankommen, oder doch wieder der Regierung in die Hände fallen?
row.short_description: In einem Universum mit getrennten Filmgenre-Welten kontrolliert ein Regime die Grenzen. Donnie entwickelt ein Gerät für unerkanntes Springen, wird aber gefasst. Widerstand und andere Gruppen versuchen, ihn zu retten. Wird er entkommen oder der Regierung in die Hände fallen?

All items are added to your Steam inventory and are fully marketable, allowing you to complete your collections with ease. Join the fun and start building your Pixelart collection today! The item/ticket drop chances are specifically designed so that there are some very rare items . Those items will be hard to get and thus all the more rewarding when you actually get one. Nevertheless it is designed so that you should get the necessary amount of each rarity in each drop pool (if you idle enough). Please keep in mind that I am a solo developer and more features are planned for the game. Features In-game inventory: To view your beautiful collection Merchant: To recycle items you don't want anymore. Favorite shelf: To display your favorite item on the main screen Discord If you want to stay informed about updates and promotions or just want to chat. About drops You can get 1-4 tickets every 2 hours (also a Steam inventory item). The possible items you get for a ticket are dependent on the ticket's rarity. You can get rarer tickets by spinning the wheel and having some luck. More infos and exact drop table/probabilities can be found on the discord. This is just an example and not the current drop pool: Drop rotation The possible drops will change every once in a while to keep things fresh and allow the items to maintain a certain rarity/value. The specific timeframe is not yet determined but I will try to aim for one week. Important The game's item/ticket drops are not hackable: Everything concerning item and ticket drops is managed through the Steam inventory service. It will never give a ticket before the 2 hours are up and it will only give a random item by consuming a ticket of the correct rarity. Suggestions/Feedback I am always open to suggestions and feedback. This is the first game I published and the first one I ever made using the Steam inventory service. If you have ideas or even some pixel art you think would fit in the game, feel free to contact me. ----------------------------- Have fun collecting!

row.name: VR traffic safety with Polly
row.detailed_description: Buying Points for a Game that Conducts Safety Education Based on Realistic Situations with Robocar Poli 1. Unlike typical safety education, it is conducted in VR, providing vivid education. 2. By recreating realistic traffic situations, it offers more effective education. 3. During play, unconscious behavior check data provides a report that can identify the child's tendencies. 4. By solving quizzes to review the previously learned traffic situations, children can learn safety rules. 5. It provides a report to know the child's traffic safety score. Game Genre Educational/Functional Game Genre Initially, functional games focused mainly on military training and promotional activities. However, it has been discovered that functional games can also achieve quick and easy effects in education and therapy. Functional games are designed to offer both fun and learning effects to users based on games. These games are sometimes referred to as edutainment (Education + Entertainment) or edu-games (Education + Game). Gelten has combined such functional games with VR, which allows for indirect experience of reality, to create VR safety education content for children. Before starting, please enter your name and contact information. A link and verification code will be sent to the provided KakaoTalk contact. After registering on the website and entering the verification code, you will be able to view the safety education report generated while playing the game. This procedure is optional. If you prefer to skip this step, you may enter any name and number.
row.short_description: VR Traffic Safety with Polly is an educational program using virtual reality (VR) technology. We provide psychological reports that analyze each child's participation, understanding and responses to identify areas where the child needs further training.
